jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Project Coordinator**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an organized and detail-oriented Project Coordinator to support daily project activities and administrative operations.

The successful candidate will assist with coordinating schedules, maintaining project documentation, updating records, and facilitating communication between team members, management, and clients.

This role combines project coordination with general office administration and requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, computer proficiency, and professional communication.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate calendars, meetings, project schedules, and related administrative activities.
* Track project timelines, maintain schedules, and assist with follow-up tasks.
* Organize and maintain project files, records, and documentation.
* Perform data entry, update spreadsheets, and ensure information is recorded accurately.
* Use Microsoft Office and other productivity software to prepare and maintain documents.
* Provide front desk support, answer incoming calls, and direct inquiries appropriately.
* Operate multi-line telephone systems and maintain professional telephone etiquette.
* Assist with general office management and administrative workflows.
* Prepare, format, and proofread documents using word processing applications.
* Communicate with clients, colleagues, and management regarding routine project and administrative matters.
* Provide customer service and administrative support as needed.
* Assist with relevant administrative tasks using QuickBooks.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Previous experience in project coordination, office administration, clerical support, or a personal assistant role is preferred.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to coordinate multiple tasks and manage changing priorities.
* Good computer literacy and familiarity with Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience with spreadsheets, word processing, data entry, and document management.
* Strong attention to detail and accurate recordkeeping skills.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills.
* Customer service experience and familiarity with front desk responsibilities.
* Comfortable handling telephone inquiries and using multi-line phone systems.
* Familiarity with QuickBooks or similar accounting software is an asset.
* Additional language skills are considered an asset.

**Work Environment**

This position involves a combination of project coordination, administrative support, and general office responsibilities. Daily activities include organizing schedules, maintaining documentation, communicating with clients and colleagues, and supporting efficient business operations.

The Project Coordinator will contribute to smooth project workflows through effective organization, timely communication, and reliable administrative assistance.

Pay: $55,800.00 - $67,300.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Reporting to the Director, LMU Extension, the incumbent will have experience in public workforce development and disability inclusion programs, particularly in the areas of grant management and program coordination for underserved and underrepresented populations. This position will be responsible for ensuring that all program activities are executed in alignment with the goals of the grant, managing relationships with stakeholders, collecting data, and preparing reports that evaluate the effectiveness of the grant’s initiatives.

**Position Specific Responsibilities/Accountabilities**

**Program Coordination & Stakeholder Engagement:**

* Coordinate all partner activities related to the grant.
* Serve as the main point of contact for all stakeholders, including state agencies, workforce agencies, community organizations, project awardees, and other external partners.
* Schedule and convene regular meetings with project stakeholders to ensure collaboration, co-enrollment, and co-case management between WIOA Title I and IV programs.
* Promote and sustain a collaborative community centered around integrated service delivery and the goals of the grant.
* Collaborate with The Coelho Center and other internal project partners to ensure program activities are coordinated and align with the goals of the grant.

**Grant & Data Management:**

* Track the progress of the grant, ensuring deliverables are met on time and in accordance with program objectives.
* Work with project partners to collect, analyze, and report on data to evaluate the success of workforce development strategies and programs for people with disabilities (PWD).
* Develop and maintain comprehensive records and data systems related to the grant’s activities, ensuring accurate and timely reporting.
* Assist in the preparation of reports for stakeholders and funders, providing updates on program progress, successes, and challenges.

**Evaluation & Reporting:**

* Coordinate and assist with the developmental evaluation efforts to document lessons learned and generate actionable recommendations for scaling successful strategies.
* Work with stakeholders to analyze program outcomes and identify areas for improvement.
* Compile and prepare detailed reports to assess the impact of pilot awardees project impact on the employment outcomes of people with disabilities.

**Travel & Outreach:**

* Occasionally travel within California to support program stakeholders and attend relevant meetings and conferences related to workforce development and disability inclusion.
* Represent LMU at community events and external meetings to foster partnerships and engage with potential grantees and other stakeholders.

**Loyola Marymount University Expectations**

Exhibit behavior that supports the mission, vision, and values of the university. Communicate and employ interpersonal actions that model high standards of professional, responsible, accountable, and ethical conduct. Demonstrate a commitment to outstanding customer service.

**Requisite Qualifications**

* Typically a Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience. Incumbent will be expected to continue upgrading knowledge, skills, and abilities needed to keep abreast of regulation/policy changes.
* Minimum of 4 years of experience in program coordination, grant management, or a related field, preferably within public workforce development programs.
* Demonstrated experience with data collection, evaluation methods, and reporting, including experience with workforce development or disability-related programs.
* Familiarity with state and federal workforce development programs, particularly in California. This includes understanding of America's Job Centers and WIOA funded programs.
* Understanding of WIOA Title I and Title IV programs, with experience working with disability inclusion initiatives.
* Proven ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare quantitative and qualitative reports.
* Strong organizational and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with diverse stakeholders.

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of this position.*

jobs.title: SLAAI Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:

**SUMMARY**

South LA All In (SLAAI) is a multi-year, coalition-driven initiative designed to address longstanding racial and socioeconomic inequities in South Los Angeles, with a focus on underserved communities east of the 110 Freeway.

SLAAI strengthens South Los Angeles through coordinated investments and partnerships in five priority areas: Good Jobs, Education, Housing Stability & Affordability, Access to Capital, and Social Infrastructure.

Reporting directly to the SLAAI Program Manager, the Program Coordinator provides day-to-day administrative and program coordination support across SLAAI initiatives. The position keeps programs organized, documented, and moving by maintaining accurate participant and partner records, coordinating logistics and communications, tracking milestones and performance data, administering surveys, and supporting timely grant and program reporting.

The Program Coordinator works closely with the SLAAI Director, Associate Director, Outreach & Engagement Manager, Outreach Coordinator, CRCD departments, community partners, and the Learning & Evaluation team. This is a coordination and implementation-support position and does not independently set program strategy, approve budgets, supervise staff, make final participant-selection decisions, or assume the direct-service responsibilities of case managers, coaches, or partner agencies.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Position roles and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
* **Program Coordination:** Maintain initiative workplans, calendars, milestone trackers, task lists, meeting schedules, and follow-up timelines across assigned SLAAI programs.
* **Meeting & Event Logistics:** Coordinate scheduling, invitations, registration, technology, materials, food, room setup, site tours, participant reminders, and other logistics for workshops, trainings, convenings, and community events.
* **Program Materials:** Prepare agendas, meeting packets, sign-in materials, presentations, resource guides, certificates, and other participant and partner documents.
* **Action Item Tracking:** Document decisions, action items, responsible parties, and deadlines; follow up to support timely completion and escalate implementation risks to the Program Manager
* **Data & Records Management:** Maintain complete, accurate, and current participant, partner, referral, attendance, service, training, and outcome records in approved systems, including SharePoint, Forstack, and initiative-specific trackers.
* **Performance Tracking:** Track enrollment, attendance, retention, training completion, referrals, service connections, exit outcomes, and other required performance indicators.
* **Survey Administration:** Coordinate pre-program, session-specific, and post-program surveys in partnership with the Learning & Evaluation team and track response completion.
* **Data Quality:** Review records for completeness, resolve routine discrepancies, and flag missing or inconsistent information before internal and external reporting deadlines.
* **Reporting Support:** Compile documentation, data summaries, success stories, and program files for quarterly and grant reporting led by the Program Manager.
* **File Management & Confidentiality:** Maintain organized, audit-ready electronic files in accordance with CRCD confidentiality, record-retention, and data-security requirements.
* **Participant & Partner Communication:** Provide timely, professional communication to participants, community-based organizations, faith-based institutions, facilitators, guest speakers, and program partners.
* **Enrollment & Onboarding Support:** Support application processing, eligibility-document collection, leadership authorizations, onboarding, and program completion documentation.
* **Engagement Follow-Up:** Track participant engagement and follow-up needs and coordinate with the appropriate outreach, program, or direct service staff when barriers arise.
* **Partner Database Management:** Maintain current contact information, participation history, program roles, referrals, and next steps for partners, facilitators, and guest speakers.
* **Post-Program Coordination:** Support follow-up visits, referrals, technical-assistance coordination, and documentation of participant or partner next steps.

**INITIATIVE-SPECIFIC PERFORMANCE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Good Jobs Network:** Document and track at least 90 youth and young adult referrals, ages 16–24, during the grant period.
* **Healthcare Career Pathways:** Track clinical and nonclinical participant enrollment, progress, and training completion.
* **Helping Families Thrive:** Maintain complete eligibility, enrollment, service, and outcome records for participating families.
* **CBO Capacity Building:** Maintain workshop attendance records and track completion of pre- and post-assessments.
* **SLAAI Capacity Building Bootcamp:** Document participation and completion of 60 hours of capacity building and technical assistance for 10 enrolled CBOs.
* **CRCD Thought Leadership:** Maintain records of conferences, presentations, audiences, topics, materials, and geographic reach.
* **Project Hope Bridge:** Maintain participant eligibility, referral, housing, service, workforce, subsidy, exit-planning, and outcome records.
* **South LA Is Home:** Maintain application, authorization, attendance, survey, partner, speaker, and next-step records for participating faith-based institutions.

**KEY PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS**

* Maintain complete and current required records for at least 95% of active participants and partners, with corrections completed by established reporting deadlines.
* Document attendance and participation for 100% of assigned workshops, convenings, trainings, and program sessions.
* Enter or update routine program data within five business days of receiving complete source documentation.
* Distribute assigned participant and partner communications by established deadlines

jobs.title: ADMINISTRATIVE SERVICES SUPERVISOR (COMMUNITY PROGRAM SPECIALIST V)
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

**EXTENDED**

**Applications are available online beginning Wednesday, November 18, 2026, through 4:30 PM, Wednesday, December 2, 2026.**

**(Applicants who have been placed on the previous qualifying list for ED26-010 - ADMINISTRATIVE SERVICES SUPERVISOR (COMMUNITY PROGRAM SPECIALIST V) do not need to reapply)**

  

**THE COMMUNITY**

Idyllically located on the Pacific Coast just south of Los Angeles and adjacent to Orange County, Long Beach is a vibrant city of approximately 450K residents. Known for its diverse and inclusive community, Long Beach features a unique blend of urban sophistication, cultural richness, and coastal charm. The City encompasses about 51 square miles, offering an array of parks, beaches, and recreational opportunities. Residents enjoy mild climate year-round perfect for outdoor activities such as biking, running, water sports, and much more. Long Beach is home to world-class attractions including the Aquarium of the Pacific, the historic Queen Mary, and the annual IndyCar Acura Grand Prix of Long Beach. Long Beach will be the largest venue city for the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games.

Long Beach also boasts a thriving economy supported by industries such as aerospace, education, health services, manufacturing, tourism and professional services. With two advanced educational institutions, California State University Long Beach and Long Beach City College, and robust K-12 schools, the City is a hub for learning and innovation. Transportation options abound. The Long Beach and Metro transit systems along with the City’s own airport provide convenient access throughout the broader Southern California region. Long Beach is recognized as one of the nation’s most walkable and bike-friendly cities.

**CITY GOVERNMENT**

Long Beach operates as a charter city governed by an elected Mayor and nine City Council members elected by district. The City Manager, appointed by the Mayor and City Council, oversees the daily operations of 15 departments and an FY26 annual budget of approximately $3.7B. The City employs over 6,000 full-time and part-time staff; dedicated to providing exceptional public services with the vast majority being represented by eleven employee associations.

* City Departments
* Citywide FY26 Budget
* 2030 Strategic Vision
* Elevate ’28 Infrastructure Investment Plan

The City of Long Beach fosters an environment where every employee is celebrated for their individuality and unique talents they bring to their role. Reflecting the diversity of the community within the workforce is a key priority embraced at every level of the organization—from management to policycreation. City Leadership actively promotes equity and inclusion by partnering with staff and community stakeholders to advance fairness in all initiatives. Transparency remains a cornerstone of these efforts with demographic data, including workforce diversity and pay equity by race and gender, shared publicly to ensure accountability and progress.

**THE DEPARTMENT OF ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT & OPPORTUNITY**

The Department of Economic Development & Opportunity is an innovative department that leverages Federal, State, and City resources to generate growth in property, sales, and transient occupancy taxes that pay for services citywide. The Department continuously works to implement the recommendations of the Grow Long Beach Economic Blueprint. This comprehensive plan provides policy recommendations and will further Long Beach as an innovative ecosystem that lays a foundation for entrepreneurial success from business start-up to growth.

The Department has approximately 90 employees with five bureaus: Business Development, Business Operations, Real Estate Development, Waterfront Development, and Workforce Development. The Department's mission is to create economic opportunities for workers, investors, and entrepreneurs with an annual budget of over $31 million from eight different City funds.

To learn more about the Department visit:

* Department Website
* Department FY 26 Budget
* Grow Long Beach Initiative
* Bureau Website

**THE POSITION**

The Community Program Specialist V (Administrative Services Supervisor) is an unclassified, at-will supervisory position that reports to the Workforce Development Officer and provides leadership and oversight for Data Management, Contracts, and Procurement.

This role is responsible for ensuring integrity, accuracy, and compliance of workforce program data across the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA) and other federal, state, and locally funded initiatives. It also oversees contract administration and procurement functions, including the development, monitoring, and compliance of program contracts and purchasing activities. The position plays a key role in strengthening performance accountability, driving continuous improvement, maintaining audit readiness, and advancing equitable service delivery.

This position supervisors a team of three staff—one Data Integrity Specialist, one Training and Contracts Coordinator, and one Contracts and Procurement Specialist, and serves as the lead authority for data governance, reporting systems, performance monitoring, and contracts and procurement functions in support of workforce development programs.

This position offers a hybrid schedule with one (1) telecommute day per work week, and the option of a 9/80 alternative work schedule.

**EXAMPLES OF DUTIES**
----------------------

**EXAMPLES OF DUTIES**

* Lead and supervise staff responsible for data management, contracts, and procurement, providing strategic direction, guidance, and performance oversight to ensure accurate and timely data reporting and effective contract and procurement administration across all workforce programs.
* Oversee and support the development, implementation, and performance monitoring of contracts and procurement activities, including training contracts and other program-related agreements

jobs.title: LLC Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**SCOPE OF RESPONSIBILITY:**

Under the direction of the Assistant Director of Housing, the LLC Program Coordinator oversees daily program operations and assigned LLC and Housing Intensive Services non-clinical staff. The Coordinator implements program priorities, monitors performance and contract requirements, and escalates significant staffing, clinical, safety, compliance, and resource concerns. The role also represents the program with internal teams, County departments, and community partners.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Manage daily LLC and Housing program operations in alignment with priorities established by the Assistant Director of Housing.
* Supervise assigned non-clinical staff through clear expectations, coaching, field supervision, coverage planning, and performance follow-up.
* Implement approved policies, procedures, corrective actions, and program-improvement plans; escalate significant concerns to the Assistant Director.
* Coordinate service delivery to meet County, contract, quality, documentation, and audit requirements.
* Monitor performance indicators, revenue, expenses, contract utilization, and slot allocations; analyze trends and recommend action.
* Represent the program in internal, external, and community meetings within delegated authority and communicate resulting commitments.
* Maintain accurate electronic records, reports, and communications using required program systems.
* Participate in required training, flexible scheduling, and the 24/7 after-hours on-call rotation.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

Master’s degree or equivalent in social work, psychology, counseling, or a related field (MSW, MA, MS, PhD, or PsyD) and a current license in good standing, with all requirements of the applicable licensing board met. The role requires strong leadership, organization, written and verbal communication, judgment, and teamwork skills, including the ability to remain calm and productive while managing competing priorities. The candidate must be able to maintain an accessible, transparent management approach.

Management experience and community mental health experience are preferred. The successful candidate must be able to adapt to change, learn multiple County systems, and use technology proficiently, including Electronic Health Records, Word, and Excel. A valid California driver’s license, at least two years of an insurable driving record, access to a personal vehicle for work-related travel, and successful TB and fingerprint clearances are required.

**CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT:**

Employees may be required to complete cross-training or additional education when determined to be in the agency’s best interest. The position requires knowledge of community resources, use of a personal vehicle with required insurance coverage for agency business, and continued compliance with Wellnest’s driving and liability-coverage standards. Employment is also conditioned on agreement to Wellnest’s Arbitration Agreement.

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

Work is performed in office, community, and field settings. The employee may be required to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, and participate in the program’s on-call rotation.

**REASONING ABILITY:**

* Present information clearly and respond appropriately to questions from clients, employees, partners, and the public.
* Read, analyze, and interpret policies, procedures, reports, and other business documents.
* Interpret written, oral, diagrammed, and scheduled instructions.
* Define problems, gather and analyze information, evaluate options, and draw sound conclusions when guidance is limited.
* Work independently and collaboratively in in-person, virtual, and telephone settings.
* Prioritize multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing demands.
* Maintain sustained attention to detail and respond professionally to sensitive inquiries or complaints.
* Apply high ethical and professional standards consistent with agency policy and community expectations.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**:

* Communicate effectively by speaking and listening.
* Stand, walk, sit, reach, and use hands to operate objects, tools, and controls.
* Use a computer keyboard for up to 25% of the workday.
* Maintain the visual acuity, focus, and peripheral vision needed to use a laptop and other office equipment.
* Lift or move up to 10 pounds.
* Operate standard office technology and equipment, including Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, electronic records systems, telephone, copier, printer, and scanner.

This job description summarizes the position’s primary duties, responsibilities, and requirements. It is not intended to list every duty the employee may be assigned.

Wellnest does not discriminate against any client, parent/guardian, employee or community member on the basis of actual or perceived ancestry, age, color, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, nationality, race or ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or association with a person or group with one or more of these actual or perceived characteristics.

Performance shall include:

* Advise government security personnel, program managers, contracting officers, and leadership on security protocol, guidance, and processes and provide comprehensive support and feedback to resolve customer security requests
* Responsible for the management of personnel security clearance requirements to include monthly clearance verification, access updates, and initiation and review of government SF 86 - Questionnaire for National Security submissions for accuracy and completeness to facilitate initial investigations, periodic reinvestigations, and security clearance upgrades as well as interim security clearance approvals.
* Implements and maintains directorate Security Education and Training Awareness program and conducts and documents initial Newcomer Security Orientation training for government and support contractors and annual security refresher training to all assigned personnel.
* Responsible for the management of the INFOSEC program and accountability of all GSA security containers for the storage of classified material and provide training to security container custodians and directorate personnel on responsibilities for protecting, marking, storing, accessing, handling, securing, and destroying classified material IAW DoDM 5200.01 V1-3\_AFMAN 16-1404V1-3.

* Possess familiarity and experience in SMO Management utilizing the Defense Information System for Security (DISS) to include clearance validation, Visit Authorization Request processing, access briefing/debriefing, Nondisclosure Agreement processing, and access/eligibility accountability.
* Monitor, review and track reporting requirements of security deficiencies, incidents, violations, and compromises to verify prompt corrective actions are accomplished as needed IAW DoDM 5200.01V1–V3\_DAFMAN 16-1404, Vols 1–3, DoDM 5200.02\_DAFMAN 16-1405, DoDM 5220.32V1\_DAFMAN 16-1406, Vol 1, DoDM 5220.32, Vol 1, DoDI 5200.48\_DAFI 16-1403, 32 CFR Part 117

* Plan, coordinate and conduct OPSEC assessments annually and report findings IAW DoDD 5205.02E, AFI 10-701
* Accomplish and verify end-of-day security checks for classified rooms and containers.
* Coordinates security efforts among the SATCOM & PNT programs and facilitates support to program managers and material leadership.

* Conduct secure equipment device management (e.g., secure telephone and encryption devices) and classified keying material inventories, inspections, and other COMSEC-related support and oversight functions
* Perform installation, troubleshooting, and support of secure communications devices and coordinate to deliver encryption device(s) and keying material to select Information Technology (IT) specialists maintaining classified networks
* Administer a Top-Secret inventory and document control program to account for classified holdings, COMSEC equipment, and materials
* Conduct inventories per agency policy and reports any discrepancy to government customer
* Manage accountability of classified courier authorizations and provide training to classified couriers on responsibilities for the protection of classified information and author receipts for classified materials
* Ensure Automated Information Systems Security requirements, related to COMSEC duties, are complied with
* Ensure proper physical security accreditation has been issued by designated Program Security Officers for supported facilities
* Train personnel in COMSEC and SVRO procedures and the use of related equipment
* Develops tracking metrics to capture recurring and ad-hoc security tasks and brief status to government security personnel
* Participates in program IPT meetings to garner insight into program security requirements and works directly with program managers to ensure programmatic requirements are met

jobs.title: Front Office and Content Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Front Office & Content Coordinator**  
Sagar Patel Aesthetics · Beverly Hills, CA · Full-time, in office

Most of our patients find us through our educational content on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, and many travel from out of state for surgery. We’re looking for someone who can do a bit of everything: keep the front office running smoothly, help on consult and surgery days, and create the photos and videos that bring patients to us. You’ll be cross-trained across the practice, so you’ll never be stuck in one lane.

**About us**  
Dr. Sagar Patel is a fellowship-trained facial plastic surgeon with a focused practice: chin liposuction, chin implants, buccal fat removal, deep neck lifts, otoplasty and forehead reduction. Most procedures are done with the patient awake under local anesthesia in our Beverly Hills office. We’re a small, close team, and everyone here covers multiple roles.

**What you’ll do**

* **Front office:** check patients in, handle confirmations and reminders, take payments and manage paperwork.
* **Consult days:** keep consults on schedule, gather intake and photos, and help with follow-up so patients know their next step.
* **Photos and content:** take standardized before-and-after photos, film in-office content, and edit short-form video for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.
* **AI and systems:** use the AI tools we run our content and workflows on, and help keep them organized as we build them out.
* **Surgery days:** prepare patients and work as an OR circulator after training.
* **Wherever you’re needed:** in a small office, everyone steps in.

**What we’re looking for**

Required:

* 1+ year in a front desk, reception or customer-facing role.
* Experience shooting and/or editing short-form video.
* Comfortable learning new software and AI tools quickly.

Preferred:

* Bachelor’s degree in communications, film, marketing or a related field.
* Experience in a medical, aesthetics or wellness practice.
* A social account or portfolio you’ve built or helped grow.
* Spanish speaking.

**Schedule**  
Full-time. Clinic days run 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. Surgery days start at 7:15 a.m.

**Pay and benefits**

* $26–$31 per hour, depending on experience
* Medical, dental and vision insurance
* 401(k) with employer contributions
* Paid time off and California paid sick leave

**How to apply**  
Send your resume and a link to one or two videos or an account you’ve shot, edited or grown.

Pay: $26.00 - $31.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

**Location:** Hawthorne, California

**Job Type:** Full-time / Part-time

**Work Location:** In person

About the Position

US Tow is looking for a dependable, organized, and resourceful individual to join our office operations team.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator (Contract)
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

**Role Overview:**

*This is a* ***6-12 month contract position*** *with the potential for extension or conversion to a full-time role based on performance and business needs. This role offers a strong opportunity to gain exposure to a fast-paced, high-growth recruiting environment and make a meaningful impact from day one.*

As a Recruiting Coordinator at CHAOS, you'll be a key player in driving our growth and expansion. Your role is vital in shaping the future success of our company, from managing daily recruitment activities to fostering positive candidate relationships throughout the entire process. You will be instrumental in creating a lasting impression on prospective candidates, setting the tone for their journey with us!

In this role, you'll report into our Recruiting Operations Manager and regularly partner with Recruiters and hiring teams to support the rapid development of our dynamic team. Your responsibilities encompass overseeing all aspects of the employee lifecycle, from interview scheduling, related logistics, and onboarding activities. Beyond that, you'll actively contribute to identifying opportunities for enhanced efficiency & improvements while exercising creativity and innovation toward making our experiences top-notch. Your primary objective will be to ensure an outstanding candidate & employee experience, making you an indispensable partner in guiding candidates seamlessly through our recruitment process and into their exciting career journey at CHAOS.

**Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate major aspects of the employee lifecycle from interview scheduling requests for candidates to executing onboarding tasks to assisting with new hire orientations
* Serve as a main point of contact with interview candidates, ensuring timely communication with them via phone, text, and email, ensuring a positive and informative experience
* Use (and identify where gaps exist) software tools to manage candidate logistics throughout the recruiting process such as booking travel & lodging accommodations, troubleshooting through last-minute scheduling changes, and facilitating onsite interview operations
* Liaise with hiring teams to ensure timely interview attendance, collect feedback and relay next steps for candidates while keeping hiring managers up to date on candidate statuses & recruiting process
* Manage logistics of the onsite interview process for candidates including: scheduling, facilitating tours, setting up conference rooms, ensuring interviewer attendance, and troubleshooting last-minute schedule changes
* Identify opportunities for process and system improvements, addressing bottlenecks and enhancing scheduling efficiency
* Cultivate strong relationships with key stakeholders, including hiring teams, Operations and IT team members
* Participate in projects to support the recruiting function
* Work full-time onsite out of our office in Los Angeles (Hawthorne), California

**Minimum Requirements:**

* 2+ years of experience in an administrative role with high-volume scheduling; preferably in a fast-paced environment
* Track record of supporting multiple scheduling or customer needs at a time with a high level of urgency
* Strong customer service mindset; proven ability to provide a candidate-first mentality, prioritizing the candidate experience throughout the recruitment process
* Process-oriented mindset with a passion for process improvement, efficiency and organization
* Ability to connect and relate to a wide range of people, personalities, and values
* Ability to thrive in a constantly evolving environment with shifting priorities
* Willingness to work in-person out of our Los Angeles (Hawthorne) office location 5 days per week

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience using ATS applications; Greenhouse experience is highly preferred
* Experience scheduling within Microsoft Outlook
* Familiarity with Slack
* Interest in the Tech Recruiting/Talent Acquisition/People Operations function as a career path

**Why CHAOS?**

* **Health Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
* **Additional benefits**: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more
* **Our Perks:** Free daily lunch, 'No meeting Fridays', unlimited PTO, casual dress code
* **Compensation Components:** Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses
* **Team Growth:** 450 employees and counting across 5 global offices

***Hourly Range: $33.00 - $42.00***

*The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.*

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator (Fixed-Term)
jobs.description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and capital-efficient approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to support a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and supporting a growing space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo's 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to design, build, and operate its own spacecraft in orbit. Next, Haven-1 is targeted to become the world's first commercial space station, with launch anticipated in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities capable of manufacturing America's next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for Mars, dedicated modules for government partners, and other crewed systems designed to unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

* Partner with recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates to keep scheduling and onsite logistics running smoothly, clear roadblocks as they come up, and build the relationships that keep our process moving.
* Help document and maintain our coordination processes, and keep them current as we grow.
* Flag friction in how we coordinate and suggest improvements.
* Take on additional projects and tasks as needed to support the broader talent operations team.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* 4+ years in recruiting coordination or a comparable administrative role
* Hands-on experience with an applicant tracking system, Greenhouse preferred
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Strong ownership mindset with a focus on outcomes, accountability, and continuous improvement

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Comfort navigating ambiguity and building without a fully defined playbook
* Experience in a fast-paced start-up or corporate environment
* Strong customer service mindset

*We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply.*

Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. jobs.title: Community Manager
jobs.description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

Asset Living is a third-party management firm and a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. Founded in 1986, Asset Living has decades of experience delivering exceptional value to our partners. Since the beginning, our undeniable passion has driven our organic growth from a small property management firm to one of the most trusted allies in real estate. Asset Living's growing portfolio includes a multitude of properties across the country that span the multifamily, single-family home rentals, affordable housing, build-to-rent, active adult, and student housing divisions.

  

Asset Living is a fast-growing company made up of talented individuals from diverse backgrounds that differentiate us and help us drive innovation and results for our clients and communities across the US. At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed’. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. Together, we create an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual experiences opportunities to grow as our company grows. When you join Asset Living, you become part of a dynamic team that thrives on unity, unique talents, and a universal culture of winning.

  

Recognized as one of the nation's Best and Brightest Places to Work and ranked in the NMHC top 50 professionals, join Asset Living because of its reputation as the most trusted partner in real estate, workplace culture, and growth opportunities. Asset Living is a member of The Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM) and is recognized as an Accredited Management Organization (AMO). Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.

**COMMUNITY MANAGER**

The Community Manager is responsible for overseeing the entire operations of a housing community under the supervision of the Regional Manager. As a Community Manager, you will manage all phases of the operations, including personnel, leasing, maintenance, financial, administration & risk management. As an on-site leader, you will supervise all aspects of the property and staff to ensure compliance with Asset’s policies and procedures, safety and fair housing guidelines, and liability concerns.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Personnel Management
* Regular/daily onsite attendance is required
* Use consistent techniques & company directives to screen, hire, train, coach, and develop on-site staff
* Ensure the effectiveness of staff through ongoing training, coaching, counseling, and guidance in compliance with Asset training benchmarks.
* Complete weekly/daily office & maintenance staff schedules and assignments
* Deal effectively and consistently with performance problems; document adequately, communicate with direct supervisor and HR, and terminate appropriately when necessary.
* Promote harmony and quality job performance of staff through support and effective leadership
* Ensure staff compliance and consistency with Company policies and procedures
* Financial Management
* Achieve the highest possible net operating income through the implementation of effective cost control and revenue & leasing improvement; identify trends and recommend strategies and adjustments
* Develop yearly operating budgets/forecasts
* Monitor the timely receipt and reconciliation of deposits, rent collections, and charges to ensure they are submitted on a timely basis.
* Monitor the timely receipt, reconciliation, and coding of all vendor invoices
* Ensure property closeout is completed on time and ownership financial reports are accurate
* Strategic Leasing Management
* Develop yearly marketing plan and utilize marketing strategies & systems
* Ensure staff leasing techniques are effective in obtaining closure, follow-up procedures met, signing/documentation of leases, and reporting systems are accurate and up to date.
* Deal with resident complaints, concerns, and requests to ensure resident satisfaction
* Develop and implement resident retention programs (i.e., resident functions, special promotions, monthly newsletter, etc.)
* Effectively show, lease, and move in prospective residents
* Administrative & Maintenance Management
* Ensure all administrative & leasing reporting is accurate, complete, and submitted on a timely basis
* Will head emergency team for the property; ensure proper response and handling of all property emergencies with staff, residents, buildings, etc., within company guidelines to minimize liability.
* Manage excellent customer service and monitor service request turnaround and responsiveness of maintenance staff.
* Maintain property appearance and ensure repairs are noted and completed on a timely basis (this requires regular property inspections and tours)
* Plan for and utilize property resources, equipment, and supplies economically (i.e., obtaining bids/pricing from vendors, suppliers, and contractors, dealing with inadequate service, etc.)
* Give direction to and monitor maintenance, construction, and rehabilitation activities to ensure quality and expediency (i.e., “walk” units to ensure make-ready and work orders are completed)

**Education/experience**

* High School Diploma or Equivalent; Bachelor’s degree preferred or four year’s experience in the housing industry; or one to two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Certified Apartment Manager (CAM) or Accredited Resident Manager (ARM) preferred.
* Ability to understand and perform all on-site software functions; basic computer skills required.
* Must have basic knowledge of Fair Housing Laws and OSHA requirements.

**Physical requirements**

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required

Hydrafacial is a global category-creating company focused on bringing innovative products to market and delivering beauty health experiences by reinventing our consumer’s relationship with their skin, their bodies and their self-confidence.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

The Program Operations Assistant will serve as an integral member of the Western Justice Center (WJC) team by supporting efficient, effective program implementation in alignment with operational policies, processes, and procedures. The role will support our conflict resolution education program teams (Restorative Schools Initiative, Training & Capacity Building), and regional trainings and initiatives ((ABCs of Conflict, Mediation Boot Camp, Peer Mediation Invitational, Circle Workshops, United Against Hate Week), as well as the day-to-day functioning of campus and office operations with consistent, quality work that upholds WJC organizational values and standards of excellence.

The Program Operations Assistant will provide administrative, logistical, and coordination support for program implementation across a variety of settings, including school sites, virtual platforms, WJC’s nonprofit campus, and other community locations as needed. Responsibilities may include coordinating program and training logistics, managing schedules, preparing agendas, planning school-site trainings, and serving as a primary point of contact for local vendors, partners, and stakeholders. Through these efforts, the Assistant will ensure that programs are organized, delivered effectively, provided with high-quality service for internal and external audiences, and are combined with strong data collection, material archiving, registration management, and cross-departmental collaboration.

**Job Responsibilities**

*General Program Administrative Support*

Provide comprehensive administrative support to the conflict resolution education team by:

* Managing calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination for team members.
* Coordinating logistics for team meetings, events, special initiatives and special projects, including supply orders, materials prep, room reservations, agendas, minutes, follow-up, survey distribution and collection, and other logistical tasks as needed.
* Performing light editing, proofreading, and distribution of internal and external reports, proposals, presentations, and communications.
* Maintaining confidential records, databases, files, and docs (electronic and physical).
* Serving as the primary point of contact for program inquiries with exceptional customer service to internal and external stakeholders.

*General Operations Administrative Support*

*Program Event Administrative Support*

Under the direction of the project and/or team leader(s), support WJC’s signature programs and training events with comprehensive logistical planning and execution from concept design through post-event evaluation, including:

* Coordination of venue logistics, room reservations, catering, audiovisual equipment, signage, transportation, event supplies.

Provide administrative and logistical support for training programs, workshops, and any other special projects related to the Restorative Schools Initiative as needed by:

* Documenting annual training calendars designed by program team leaders, and coordinating training schedules with schools, community partners, volunteers, and facilitators.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & BD Associate
jobs.description:
Devoted Studios is a globally remote game development company specializing in Co-development, Porting, and End-to-End Art Production for the global gaming industry. We collaborate across time zones to support projects on all major platforms, engines and styles - from AAA titles to emerging technologies.

Our team includes world-class talents who bring deep expertise in external development, pipeline optimization, and creative problem-solving. Whether it's porting games to new systems, enhancing gameplay features, or crafting stunning visuals, Devoted Studios operates as a trusted, flexible extension of our partners' internal teams.

We are proud to be the development partner of choice for industry leaders such as:

* 2K
* Xbox
* Meta
* Obsidian Entertainment
* Turtle Rock Studios
* Gearbox Software

### **About the Role**

Our CEO is deeply involved in sales, partnerships, and running the company day-to-day. We're looking for someone based in Los Angeles who can work alongside her and help turn client conversations and opportunities into real execution across the company.

This is a hands-on, high-trust role. Much of the work involves coordinating internal teams, organizing proposals and deal materials, and ensuring follow-through after client discussions.

We are actively building AI-driven workflows across the company, and the right person will be excited about experimenting with AI tools, automation, and cloud systems while helping implement them across the organization.

### **Responsibilities**

**Sales & Client Partner**

* Act as the CEO’s right hand across the full sales cycle, from first conversation to signed deal and ongoing relationship, so she can focus on opening, closing and growing accounts.
* Keep the CEO’s pipeline moving: track every opportunity she’s involved in, own the next steps, and make sure no deal stalls for lack of follow-up.
* Turn the CEO’s client and partner conversations into structured action plans, and rally the right people across BD, production and pre-production to deliver proposals, estimates and materials on time.
* Prepare the CEO for client and partner meetings with sharp, research-backed briefs, and own follow-up afterwards.
* Build decks, documentation and materials for client, partner and contract conversations.
* Stay on top of video game industry news and bring the CEO opportunities, partners and market moves worth acting on.
* Keep the CRM accurate for every account the CEO touches, and report weekly on where each relationship and deal stands.
* Support BD trainings, initiatives and summits that grow the BD team.

**Conferences, Events & Community** (a creative, high-energy part of the role)

* Plan and run the CEO's conference presence end to end, including meeting schedules, materials, travel and logistics, and travel with the CEO when needed.
* Plan and execute company events, industry gatherings, mixers and community initiatives, with related marketing coordination and materials.
* Drive podcast organization and growth with Marketing, including guests, scheduling and production coordination.

**Running the CEO's World**

* Manage and prioritize the CEO's calendar, protect her time, and act as gatekeeper against low-value demands.
* Review and triage the CEO's email, draft replies, take over communications where appropriate, and surface only what needs her.
* Track the CEO's open items and personally chase them across departments, including documents, signatures, approvals and answers, until each one is closed.
* Keep a running tracker of open items and review it with the CEO weekly, so nothing lives in her head.

**In-Person Operations & CEO Co-Pilot**

* Handle everything that needs a person physically there: errands, appointments, home and life coordination, and other personal needs, so they don't pull the CEO's attention from running the company.
* Own the legwork on government and administrative filings, including IRS submissions, working with Finance on content and tracking every item to completion.
* Notice what needs handling and step in proactively, before being asked.
* Be a trusted, steady presence alongside the CEO and create the conditions for her to do her best work.

**Success in the First 30 Days**

* The CEO's calendar runs with no misses.
* Every client meeting has a brief before it and a follow-up within 24 hours.
* An open-items tracker is live and reviewed weekly.
* You own the plan for the next conference end to end.

  
**Requirements**

**Who We're Looking For**

* A driver and finisher who gets people moving, chases things down, and closes loops without being reminded.
* Writes everything down, tracks everything, and reports status before being asked.
* Thrives in a hands-on role that moves between client-facing work and personal support in the same day.
* Has experience as a project manager, producer, or executive assistant to a founder or talent.
* Comfortable working in spreadsheets, Google Workspace, and email-heavy coordination.
* Eager to experiment with AI tools, automation, and cloud systems in practical ways.
* Can coordinate stakeholders, hold people accountable to commitments, and keep work moving.
* Eligible to work in the United States.
* Available for occasional conference or event support.
* Game industry knowledge is a plus, not a requirement. You'll be trained in your first 30 days.
* Client-facing experience such as account coordination or event sales support is a plus.
* This role includes hands-on personal and administrative support. If that feels beneath you, this isn't your role.

  
**Benefits**

**Why join us? We offer:**

* 401k
* Healthcare
* Paid vacation
* Company closure in Summer and Christmas (1 week for both) as additional paid time off

jobs.title: Assistant Manager, Marketing Communications
jobs.description:
Epson is a global technology leader whose philosophy of efficient, compact and precise innovation enriches lives and helps create a better world. We are seeking an Assistant Manager, Marketing Communications, to lead high-impact campaigns and marketing initiatives that bring Epson's products to market, engage our customers and contribute directly to the company's success.

You will combine strategic marketing judgment with hands-on execution, partner with teams across the business and strengthen the workflows that move campaigns and product launches from concept to market. This is an opportunity to shape how the team works, develop its capabilities and increase its strategic and business impact.

  

This position will be based at Epson America's headquarters in Los Alamitos, California, with the opportunity for a hybrid work schedule.

  

**Marketing Communications and Creative Delivery**

**People and Relationship Leadership**

**Business and Budget Management**

**What You Will Bring:**

* Experience directing agencies, vendors and creative resources from briefing through final delivery.
* Experience with project management software like Wrike, Asana or other industry standard platform a must
* Knowledge of retail, channel marketing and point-of-sale environments is strongly preferred.

**Employee Benefits**

In addition to joining a team of dedicated professionals who support each other and are passionate about their work, you’ll also enjoy a variety of attractive, industry-leading benefits.

The starting annual base pay for this role is between USD $113,563 and $149,052. Please note that this position’s salary range may include multiple levels. The actual base is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. **Epson America, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability and protected veteran status, as well as any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Reliable Industrial Supplies

Customer Service & Purchasing Coordinator

* Reliable Industrial Supplies is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Customer Service & Purchasing Coordinator to work directly with our VA Hospital customers.
* We work almost exclusively with U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) hospitals and healthcare facilities. This position plays an important role in helping VA facilities source and receive the medical, industrial, maintenance, and other products they need.
* The ideal candidate should be enthusiastic about supporting VA facilities and the people who serve our nation’s veterans. You will communicate directly with VA customers while managing orders from the initial request or purchase order through sourcing, purchasing, shipping, invoicing, and final delivery.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is organized, resourceful, comfortable working independently, and complex problem solving.

Location

* On site in Huntington Beach, CA for a probationary period of 2-4 months
* Following a probationary training period, the position will be mostly remote with some required on-site office days & facility visits.
* Some infrequent travel required to local VA facilities, 1-2 times per month

Requirements

* Must be able to lift/carry 50lbs
* High School Diploma (or Equivalent GED)
* Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S
* Must have a valid Drivers License and clean driving record
* Must be able to communicate effectively in English. Both verbally and in writing.
* Be dependable, organized, and able to manage multiple tasks and orders simultaneously

Join Reliable Industrial Supplies

This position is ideal for someone who wants more than a traditional customer-service role. You’ll become involved in the entire order process, from receiving a request from a VA facility and researching the product to purchasing, shipping, invoicing, and confirming delivery.

If you are dependable, highly organized, comfortable with detailed administrative work, and excited about supporting VA hospitals and the facilities that care for our nation’s veterans, we encourage you to apply.

The right candidate is:

* Highly motivated and enthusiastic about working directly with VA hospitals and facilities.
* Extremely detail-oriented and comfortable double-checking their work.
* Organized and able to manage multiple customer orders at the same time.
* A strong written and verbal communicator.
* Professional and comfortable speaking with VA customers, vendors & manufacturers
* A resourceful problem-solver who enjoys researching products and finding answers.
* Able to follow established procedures while knowing when to ask for assistance.
* Reliable, responsive, and able to follow tasks through to completion.
* Comfortable working with numbers, pricing, invoices, and spreadsheets.
* Able to work independently while communicating effectively with the team.

Computer & Administrative Skills

Experience or comfort with the following is helpful but we are willing to train the right person if needed.

* QuickBooks, Microsoft Excel Spreadsheets
* Email and electronic file organization
* Online vendor and manufacturer websites
* UPS and FedEx shipping systems
* Product and inventory research
* Data entry and order tracking

Previous experience with VA facilities, government purchasing, medical supplies, industrial supplies, purchasing, distribution, logistics, or customer service is a plus, but is not required.

This Position Is a Good Fit If You…

* Are genuinely interested in working with and supporting VA facilities.
* Like figuring out where to find hard-to-source or unusual products.
* Enjoy helping customers get what they need quickly and accurately.
* Are naturally organized and notice small details.
* Don’t mind switching between phone calls, emails, spreadsheets, purchasing, research, and order processing throughout the day.
* Take ownership of your work and follow tasks through to completion.
* Are comfortable asking questions when something doesn’t look right.
* Enjoy a fast-moving environment where every order can be a little different.

Why This Role Matters

Our VA hospital customers depend on us to locate products, provide accurate pricing, process their orders, coordinate purchasing and shipping, and keep them informed from start to finish. Sometimes the items we are getting for these hospitals are crucial to time sensitive procedures.

The work you do in this position directly supports facilities serving our nation’s veterans. Accuracy, responsiveness, follow-through, and customer service are extremely important to us.

If you’re organized, resourceful, detail-oriented, and enjoy being the person who figures things out, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

Customer Service & Order Processing

* Communicate directly with VA Hospital and VA facility customers by phone and email.
* Receive customer purchase orders and accurately enter into QuickBooks.
* Collect and document purchase order numbers, customer contact information, item numbers, quantities, pricing, and delivery requirements.

* Respond to customer questions regarding pricing, product availability, existing orders, billing, and shipping.
* Consistently follow up with customers by phone and email.

Product Research & Sourcing : Research is a major part of this position.

* Research medical, industrial, maintenance, and other requested products for VA customers using vendor websites, manufacturer resources, spreadsheets, email records, and online resources.

* Confirm product availability and lead times with vendors.

jobs.title: Client Growth Manager (SaaS / Client Success)
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Sunshine Ecommerce LLC is a fast-growing eCommerce SaaS ecosystem helping entrepreneurs launch, manage, and scale online businesses across the United States.

We work closely with our clients to help them grow their businesses through strategic guidance, marketing solutions, operational support, and ongoing business development.

We are expanding our Irvine team and looking for **ambitious, motivated, and results-driven sales professionals** who thrive in a fast-paced environment and are passionate about building client relationships, driving revenue, and exceeding sales goals.

**About The Role**

We are seeking a **Sales Account Manager / Business Growth Manager** to manage and grow an existing portfolio of clients.

* **Sales-Focused Position:** Work toward individual monthly revenue targets and performance goals.
* **Account Management:** Manage existing client relationships while identifying opportunities for business growth.
* **Upselling & Cross-Selling:** Generate additional revenue by offering products, marketing services, advertising solutions, and other business growth opportunities.
* **Client Communication:** Engage with clients through Zoom meetings, phone calls, Intercom messaging, SMS, and email.
* **Revenue Generation:** Close deals, consistently achieve monthly sales targets, and maximize revenue opportunities.
* **Relationship Building:** Develop strong, long-term client relationships that encourage retention and repeat business.
* **Consultative Selling:** Confidently present solutions, discuss investments, handle objections, negotiate, and close sales.
* **Proactive Sales Approach:** Take initiative, identify opportunities, and maintain consistent follow-ups to drive results.

**Ideal Candidate:** A confident, persuasive, self-motivated, and results-driven sales professional who thrives in a performance-based environment.

Your goal is to build strong client relationships, improve engagement, support account growth, and help clients stay active and successful long-term.

**This is a relationship-driven role that combines:**

* customer success,
* SaaS account management,
* retention,
* business consulting,
* and account growth.

This is NOT a cold-calling or high-pressure sales role.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage and grow relationships with existing clients
* Conduct onboarding and strategy Zoom calls
* Help clients navigate and scale their businesses
* Increase long-term client engagement and retention
* Support account expansion and re-investment
* Monitor account health and performance
* Communicate consistently through Zoom, phone, Intercom, text, and email
* Maintain accurate CRM and client communication records
* Collaborate with internal teams to improve client experience

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
* Strong relationship-building and interpersonal abilities
* Fast learner with strong adaptability
* Positive, professional, and solution-oriented mindset
* Strong consistency and follow-up skills
* Ability to deliver a premium, white-glove customer experience
* Comfortable communicating through Zoom, phone, text, and messaging platforms
* Strong emotional intelligence and people skills
* Highly organized and self-motivated
* Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment

**Preferred Experience**

Experience in any of the following is highly preferred:

* eCommerce
* SaaS platforms
* Customer Success
* Client Relations
* Account Management
* Retention
* Sales or Consulting
* Digital Marketing
* Online business operations

Experience with CRM systems, Intercom, Zoom, or similar sales and communication platforms is a plus.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* $60,000 annual base salary
* **Additional $30,000–$50,000 in potential annual commissions and performance bonuses**, based on individual sales performance and target achievement
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Paid Holidays
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Paid training and onboarding
* Career growth opportunities
* Potential hybrid work flexibility after three months, subject to sales performance and management approval

**Work Schedule**

* Full-time
* Monday–Friday
* **Fully in-office during the first three months of employment**. After three months, employees may be eligible for **one remote workday per week**, subject to individual sales performance and management approval.
* Remote work eligibility is performance-dependent and may be modified, suspended, or revoked based on current sales results, productivity, and business needs.
* Employees are expected to maintain consistent performance and meet established sales targets to retain hybrid flexibility.

**Who We're Looking For**

We're looking for **motivated sales professionals who enjoy building relationships but are equally passionate about closing deals and achieving results.**

You should be someone who:

* Enjoys sales and is motivated by commission opportunities.
* Is confident speaking with clients and recommending solutions.
* Takes initiative rather than waiting for opportunities.
* Is comfortable being held accountable to monthly sales targets.
* Thrives in a goal-oriented, competitive, and supportive team environment.
* Is eager to learn, improve, and grow professionally.

**If you're a driven sales professional who enjoys working with existing clients, identifying growth opportunities, and earning commission based on performance, we'd love to hear from you!**

Pay: $60,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

* Dental insurance

At Cumming Group, you will work on some of the world's most exciting projects in a dynamic environment where your success is measured by the impact you make. Cumming Group is seeking a Construction Project Coordinator to join our Bay Area Project Cost Management Department to support a key client capital program in South San Francisco. This position will be expected to support a Senior Cost Manager or Project Controls Manager with project administration on project sites and/or Cumming Group office. * Ability to lift and transport up to 50 pounds on occasion and up to 35 pounds regularly
* Exceptional verbal and written communication

* BS/BA or equivalent experience
* 1 - 2 years project management experience in an engineering environment
* Detail oriented with project management skills
* Experience with the analysis of large and complex data sets highly desirable

jobs.title: Special Education Program Specialist
jobs.description:
Description

Amethod Public Schools (AMPS) is a mission and values-driven organization. Our mission is to provide a fundamental and rigorous college preparatory education to any student who chooses one of our schools. Our day-to-day work is embodied with a set of core values: **Students First, Be Adaptable,** **Persevere, Take Responsibility, and Commitment to Distinction** or team members who exude these values and a passion for our mission.

**Position Summary**

Under the direction of the Chief Academic Officer or Special Education Designee, the Program Specialist assists and provides administrative support in all matters pertaining to key functions of the Special Education Local Plan Area (SELPA), including but not limited to: contract documentation; reconciliation of special education invoices with special education services defined in Individual Education Programs (IEPs); IEP compliance and monitoring; professional development; timely/accurate reporting to the California Department of Education Special Education Division; and managing special education transportation.

**Major duties and responsibilities:**

* Plans programs, provides curricular resources and technical assistance for, and assesses the effectiveness of the program for students with exceptional needs for all Amethod schools
* Ensures the use of best practices in the implementation of pre-referral behavioral interventions, positive behavioral interventions as outlined in the IEP, and implementation of behavioral support and intervention plans by collaborating with school psychologists, other specialists, or site staff, including providing professional development as needed
* Provides leadership in the area of curriculum, instruction, and modification/accommodation for students with diverse learning needs
* Participates in professional development and provides training and support to the Special Ed Team to enhance instruction for students with social communication, behavioral, and learning challenges
* Assumes responsibility for appropriate identification, educational programming, and services for special education students
* Leverages individual and cultural diversity, demonstrating knowledge and understanding of working with ELL students
* Provides support for data-driven decision-making and accountability to improve the instructional program and ensure student progress
* Ensures due process requirements are met to complete the appropriate development of IEPs and provides ongoing monitoring to ensure IDEA compliance
* Participates in evaluation of Ed Specialists and Paraprofessionals and provides support to Principals in the supervision of special education team members.
* Manages complex cases to ensure appropriate special education services, including attending staffing meetings, IEP meetings, and parent conferences
* Applies conflict resolution strategies with parents or other educational partners to resolve disputes related to a student’s IEP, demonstrating knowledge of current IDEA and Amethod policy and procedures
* Assists in the design and facilitation of network-wide professional development for staff, including onboarding of Special Education team members
* Participate in the designing and redesigning of the Amethod special educational program
* Assists in recruiting and screening of special education staff
* Conduct class observation and speak with teachers to support and monitor all behavioral RTI data
* Support in planning and implementing teacher in-service and professional development at each school site
* Perform other related duties as required and assigned

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Broad understanding of the MTSS/RTI structure as it relates to school reform
* Ability to use data for decision-making regarding student needs
* Ability to support professional development in all aspects of intervention methods both academic and behavioral needs
* Ability to work in a high demand environment
* Proven successful teaching or related service experience in Special Education

**Minimum qualifications:**

* Clear CA Education Specialist Credential and CLAD certification required OR CA Related Service Provider Credential/License (School Psychology, Speech and Language Therapy, Occupational Therapy, etc.)
* CPI certification desired
* Bilingual- Spanish desired
* Minimum 3 years of related experience in special education leadership

**Compensation**

The salary range for this position is $85,000 - $105,000. Salary is commensurate with experience, education, and expertise. A competitive benefits package is also offered. This is a full-time, exempt, 100% in-person position.
