jobs.title: Development Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
Development and Administrative Coordinators (DACs) at A.M. Crawford, Inc. (AMC) fulfill a hybrid role that supports **administrative operations, client-facing fundraising work, and organizational knowledge management**. The DAC works closely with AMC staff to provide administrative assistance, manage projects, support client engagement, and oversee office and information systems that enable the firm to operate efficiently and consistently.

Specifically, DACs provide administrative support to the leadership team and consultants in the **design, development, and submission of high quality grant proposals** on behalf of non-profit clients in the industrial trades, social development, environment, education, and inclusion fields. DCs also support in helping build and manage a pipeline of funder solicitations and request for proposal opportunities from relevant philanthropic, corporate social responsibility, state actor, and federal agency funders, ensuring that team deadlines are met, tasking is clear, coordination and communication is consistent, and submissions are complete. DACs assist in the **review and select writing of various written outputs**, including client reports, proposal submissions, and grant management deliverables, as well as , and coordinating various office support services including emails, appointments, and deadline calendars. The DAC will also work collaboratively with the AMC team to schedule activities, assist with research, manage databases, and complete other related proposal development and client management work as needed.

In addition to core administrative and fundraising support responsibilities, the DAC plays an important role in **capturing, organizing, and maintaining institutional knowledge**, including documentation, transcripts, research materials, and internal resources. The DAC is expected to be **curious about and comfortable experimenting with AI and digital productivity tools**, and to contribute ideas for improving workflows, documentation, and internal learning systems.

The DAC is evaluated based on:

* How effectively they carry out assigned responsibilities
* Overall client and employee satisfaction (as measured by formal and informal feedback)
* Progress toward performance goals outlined in annual goal-setting worksheets

Prior professional experience in a non-profit fundraising or federal grants and contracts business development role is preferred but not required. Familiarity with the proposal lifecycle (i.e., from opportunity identification through to post-submission management), non-profit fundraising databases (e.g., Candid, Instrumentl, etc.), and federal awards management processes (including from USAID, the Department of Labor, and other agencies) is highly preferred.

We are most interested in candidates with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to learn grant writing systems and requirements quickly.

**Status:** Full-Time, Non-Exempt

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM (three or more days per week in the office with up to two remote days as approved); on occasion, additional in-office or remote workdays may be required based on project or organizational needs.

**Salary:** $26.38 per hour, plus $5.77/hr (equivalent of $1000/month) Bay Area stipend; in accordance with AMC’s Pay Equity Policy, salary is non-negotiable

**Reports To:** Lead Consultant II

**Location:** San Francisco, CA (hybrid with three days per week in office)

  

### **Core Responsibilities**

**Administrative and Operational Support**

* Manage and maintain deadline calendars and schedule deadline-associated tasks for client deliverables and internal workflows.
* Coordinate meetings for clients and internal teams, including preparing materials, collecting information, taking notes or minutes as needed, and tracking follow-up actions.
* Perform general office and administrative duties, including communicating in a clear and professional manner, organizing and responding to information requests, and ordering office supplies.
* Manage timely email and instant messaging correspondence; organize, prioritize, and respond to incoming communications to support efficient operations.
* Maintain efficient, well-organized filing systems (i.e., paper and electronic), ensuring records are accurate, accessible, and up to date across platforms such as Google Drive.
* Track all hours and projects accurately in Asana and Harvest in accordance with company policies.
* Communicate professionally and effectively with the CEO, COO, staff, consultants, and clients as needed.
* Maintain confidentiality of all client and company information at all times.

### **Fundraising and Client Support**

* Assist in the preparation of grant proposals, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to funder guidelines.
* Track and maintain records of all grant applications, including deadlines, requirements, submissions, reporting obligations, and outcomes.
* Proofread, format, and prepare professional documents and proposals using Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and other relevant software platforms.
* Collaborate with AMC staff to research and identify potential funding opportunities, including foundation grants and other institutional sources.
* Research and maintain information from foundation and grant databases to support client fundraising strategies and proposal development.

Knowledge Management and AI-Enabled Support

* Support AMC’s organizational knowledge management efforts by ensuring key information, processes, and institutional knowledge are documented, organized, and accessible.
* Organize, label, and maintain internal knowledge assets, including
  + Meeting recordings and transcripts (including Gemini-generated transcripts)
  + Research libraries, reference materials, and internal documentation
  + Knowledge repositories and workspaces housed in tools such as NotebookLM
* Setup, maintain, and refine internal AI tools and workspaces,

jobs.description:
Account Manager

Global Fire and Safety is hiring an Account Manager to prepare cost estimates and customer quotes for marine fire suppression, detection, and life-saving equipment. You’ll work from customer requests for quotes (RFQs), parts lists, and supplier catalogs to source equipment, evaluate pricing and lead times, calculate margins, and build proposals in Salesforce.

You’ll work with Sales, Operations, Purchasing, Logistics, Accounting, and field technicians to support customer service, inspections, repairs, and renewals. The team shares responsibility for customer service, and you’ll be accountable for the quotes and assignments you handle. Assignments may shift as workloads and business priorities change.

**What you’ll do**

* Prepare itemized estimates, bills of materials, and proposals for marine equipment, spare parts, and equipment packages.
* Request and compare quotes from manufacturers, distributors, and freight partners. Evaluate availability, lead times, freight costs, delivery commitments, and supplier reliability.
* Apply pricing guidelines, volume discounts, and target margins. Recommend pricing exceptions, alternate suppliers, or revised terms for nonstandard requests.
* Advise leadership on whether to pursue, revise, or decline complex bids based on profitability, supplier risk, and the ability to meet customer commitments. Document the rationale for significant recommendations.
* Prepare proposals with itemized pricing, lead times, payment terms, and exclusions for Sales or Account Management review.
* Track quotes, supplier pricing, and bid results in Salesforce and Uptick. Use supplier performance and bid history to recommend improvements to sourcing and quoting practices.
* Hand off won quotes and supporting vendor documentation to Purchasing, Logistics, and Order Fulfillment.
* Communicate promptly with customers and internal teams, keep quote records accurate, and cross-train to support changing workloads.

**What you’ll bring**

**Required**

* High school diploma or GED.
* Experience in commercial estimating, inside sales quoting, procurement, or industrial equipment supply.
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce and Uptick or comparable quoting or field service software.
* Strong Excel skills, including formulas, lookup functions such as VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP, and pricing spreadsheets.
* Strong numerical accuracy, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple quote deadlines and communicate clearly with customers, vendors, and internal teams.

**Preferred**

* Two or more years of maritime industry experience.
* Associate or bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain, logistics, or a related field.
* Familiarity with marine or industrial fire and life safety equipment, such as extinguishers, suppression cylinders and components, alarm components, self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA), life jackets, or life rafts.

**Work environment**

This role primarily involves computer and telephone work in an office setting and may involve occasionally lifting or moving items up to 20 pounds. --------------------

The Service Account Manager is responsible for driving growth of Southland Industries' service business by developing new customer relationships, expanding existing accounts, and serving as a trusted advisor for building owners and facility managers. This role focuses on selling service maintenance agreements, repair services, retrofit projects, and other owner-direct solutions within an assigned territory. Through proactive prospecting, strategic account management, and consultative selling, this individual plays a key role in achieving revenue goals, strengthening long-term customer partnerships, and positioning Southland Industries as the preferred building solutions provider. The Service Account Manager is accountable for maintaining a healthy sales pipeline, achieving annual sales targets, and identifying opportunities that create lasting value for both customers and Southland Industries.

* Prospects within assigned market territories to develop and cultivate new owner-direct and existing building customers.
* Sells service maintenance agreements, repair services, retrofit projects, and other truck-based service solutions.

* Maintains regular customer communication and partners with service teams to ensure customer satisfaction.

* Generates new sales opportunities through networking, referrals, prospecting, and relationship-building activities.
* Identifies new business opportunities across Southland's service offerings and acts as a trusted building solutions advisor.

* Strong collaboration and problem-solving abilities.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Refold**
----------------

Enterprise integrations are still built by hand, one customer at a time, by a human supply chain of consultants. We think that's the last big software category that hasn't been automated — and we're automating it.

Refold is the AI integration delivery layer. Our agents build, test, deploy, and maintain integration workflows inside our customers' own products, white-labeled, up to 90% faster. Trained on millions of real-world contexts across SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, and Salesforce, we turn integration work that used to take quarters into days — and then keep it running, because the agents detect failures and repair mappings themselves.

**Traction:** 30+ paying enterprise customers, 1,500+ active users, 10M+ API calls processed daily, seven-figure ARR. Customers include Incorta, Kantata, Coupa, Naehas, OvationCXM, and Zycus. The results are the pitch: Kantata ships integrations 75% faster with 8x delivery capacity; Incorta cut time-to-go-live by 70% and recovered 8,000+ engineering hours; Naehas went from 3–5-month builds to 90% faster delivery.

Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia and Abhishek Kumar, who have been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30. We've raised $6.5M led by Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber) and Tidal Ventures, with Better Capital, Ahead VC, Karman Ventures, Z21 Ventures, and Titan Ventures participating.

We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one. This is an early BDR seat and the pipeline engine for our US market. If you want a role where your outbound directly decides whether the company hits its number, this is it.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Own the top of the funnel:** Research, target, and break into software companies in supply chain, procurement, finance, and professional services automation — the ones where an ERP connector is the thing standing between them and their next enterprise deal
* **Write outbound that earns a reply:** No spray and pray. Our best sequences are built on real triggers — a company hiring integration engineers, an integrations page with six connectors and a "contact us" for the rest, a public complaint about implementation timelines
* **Work the signals:** Learn to hear the buying triggers on a first call — "we rebuild integrations for every customer," "we lost a deal because we didn't have the connector," "our SI missed the deadline again" — and know exactly what to do with each one
* **Run the AI stack:** We already run an AI SDR for enrichment and first-touch outreach. Your edge isn't volume; it's judgement — which accounts matter, which message lands, and when a human needs to take over
* **Qualify with rigour:** Run sharp first conversations, qualify honestly, and hand off to the AE with context they can actually use. A meeting that shouldn't have been booked costs us more than a meeting we missed
* **Go multi-channel:** Email, LinkedIn, phone, and in person. You will pick up the phone
* **Work the room:** Book meetings around PMA, SAP Connect, TSIA, Ai4, and our executive dinner series — before, during, and after
* **Keep the data honest:** HubSpot hygiene, clean notes, accurate stages. Our forecasting is only as good as your inputs

**Role Information**
--------------------

* **Target accounts:** Sales-led software companies with an integrations page, an internal professional services team or SI dependency, and enterprise deals that hinge on connectors
* **Personas you'll open:** CTOs, CPOs, VPs of Product, and VPs of Professional Services / Delivery
* **Average deal size you're feeding:** $50–100K land / $200–300K expand
* **Current growth team:** 1 BDR, 1 AE, 2 Marketing, 4 Post-Sale, plus a 20-person engineering and delivery org
* **Path:** This is a clear on-ramp to an AE seat for someone who earns it

**Required Skills & Abilities**
-------------------------------

* **Outbound reps on the board:** 1–3 years in a BDR, SDR, or business development role. At least a year of genuine cold outbound — you've built lists, run sequences, and made the calls
* **Phone-ready:** You're not precious about cold calling, and you don't hide behind email
* **You can write:** A four-sentence email that a CTO actually answers is a real skill, and you have it, or you're obsessed with getting it
* **Technically curious:** You don't need an engineering background, but you should want to understand what an integration is, why it breaks, and why our customers care
* **High output, high coachability:** You take feedback in the morning and apply it that afternoon. You track your own numbers before anyone asks
* **Presence matters:** Based in the SF Bay Area and ready to collaborate in-office 3 days a week

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Prospected into technical buyers or software companies rather than SMB generalists
* Hands-on with HubSpot, Clay, Sales Navigator, or AI-assisted prospecting tooling
* Been the first or second BDR somewhere and had to build the motion, not inherit a playbook
* A technical background, a side project, or anything that shows you can learn a complex product fast

**Compensation:**

**Why do you want to work here?**

* **Impact:** Fast-growing seed-stage company ($6.5M from Eniac Ventures & Tidal Ventures) with early Fortune 500-scale deployments and real, quantified customer outcomes
* **Speed:** Early GTM seat with direct founder access and a visible path to closing your own deals
* **Ownership:** You'll help write the outbound playbook, not just execute someone else's

**About the Opportunity**

**JOB SUMMARY**

  

The Faculty Operations Coordinator is part of a shared services model established to provide consistent, campus-wide administrative, operational, and experiential learning support to Oakland faculty. Serving all colleges represented on the Oakland campus and more than 150 faculty members across six campus buildings, this position functions as a central resource designed to grow alongside the campus. The position reports to the Associate Dean of Academic Programs.

The Faculty Operations Coordinator works with a high level of autonomy, initiative, and discretion to support the day-to-day operational needs of faculty. The incumbent is expected to exercise independent judgment within assigned areas of responsibility, proactively identify and address needs before they become problems, and lay the groundwork for a shared services model that will expand over time. As the program grows, this role may take on supervisory responsibilities.

  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

  

Bachelor's degree required. 2-3 years experience in education administration, operations, event management, or a related field. Demonstrated experience supporting faculty and leaders in a complex, service-oriented environment a plus.

Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, including exceptional writing and proofreading abilities. High proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams. Proven ability to work effectively with a diverse population of students, faculty, staff, and community partners.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, exercises sound judgment and discretion, builds productive relationships across stakeholder groups, and thrives in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities. Experience overseeing staff or student employees and supporting complex events or campus initiatives is a plus.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & ACCOUNTABILITIES**

  

Administrative & Classroom Support

* Manage supply inventory, ordering, and distribution; ensure supply closets and printer paper are consistently stocked across campus buildings
* Coordinate mail distribution and monitor facilities needs, escalating and following through on issues with appropriate contacts

* Assist faculty with reimbursements and provide Workday onboarding support for student research assistants

* Print and prepare classroom materials as requested by faculty

* Lead faculty onboarding for new and incoming faculty members, ensuring a consistent and well-coordinated experience
* Manage space allocation for faculty across the campus, including hoteling desks and shared workspaces
Serve as the primary resource and escalation point for Faculty Leads requiring additional administrative support  

Experiential Learning Support

* Coordinate faculty experiential learning requirements with the Director, Experiential Learning and campus operations team, including logistics with speakers, partners, and other campus guests; responsibilities may include drafting MOUs, managing transportation, and serving as a liaison with campus partners

Coordinate with campus teams to support faculty events.  



Faculty Support Operations & Demand Management

* Serve as the primary intake point for faculty support requests across all Oakland colleges, establishing a consistent and transparent process for receiving, triaging, and responding to needs

* Develop and maintain systems and workflows to manage the volume and variety of faculty support demand on a fast-paced, multi-college campus, ensuring requests are prioritized and addressed efficiently

* Build and refine operational infrastructure for the shared services model, including tools, tracking, communication protocols, and service standards, with an eye toward scalability as the program grows

* Proactively identify patterns in faculty need and surface opportunities to improve service delivery, reduce friction, and better support the academic mission of the campus

* Maintain clear and consistent communication with Faculty Leads and the Academic Programs and Operations team regarding service capacity, priorities, and status of ongoing requests

Plan and support campus Faculty events.  



General Administrative Duties

* Coordinate, schedule, and provide day-to-day oversight of undergraduate and graduate student assistants as needed; support onboarding in Workday and manage task assignments, time, and payroll

* Maintain current knowledge of university policies, regulations, and procedures; ensure compliance within assigned areas

* Serve as a working resource for Workday, Microsoft 365, and other HR, finance, and purchasing platforms

* Ensure compliance with established safety policies, practices, and procedures

Perform other related duties as assigned  



This position is full-time, exempt, and benefits-eligible. This position description is not intended to contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties, or responsibilities. Additional duties may be assigned based on operational needs.

General Administration

Location

MANHATTAN

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Department of Social Services (DSS) is comprised of the administrative units of the New York City Human Resources Administration (HRA) and the Department of Homeless Services (DHS). HRA is dedicated to fighting poverty and income inequality by providing New Yorkers in need with essential benefits such as Food Assistance and Emergency Rental Assistance. DHS is committed to preventing and addressing homelessness in New York City by employing a variety of innovative strategies to help families and individuals successfully exit shelter and return to self-sufficiency as quickly as possible.
  
  
Family Independence Administration (FIA) provides temporary help to individuals and families with social service and economic needs to assist them in reaching self-sufficiency via essential and diverse programs/services, such as: temporary cash assistance, SNAP, childcare, eviction prevention services, adult protective services, job training, employment plans/support, domestic violence assistance, child support enforcement, etc.
  
  
Under general direction, with wide latitude for independent initiative and judgment, the Model Center Project Coordinator assists FIA Deputy Commissioner for Operations and the Regional Office management in planning, implementing, coordinating, monitoring, and evaluating all activities related to the community- based Model Job Centers. He or She prepares evaluation reports by consolidating various Center operations and prepares management reports using Microsoft Excel or similar analytical tools depicting performance by Center and Worker level, as necessary.
  
  
FIA’s Operations is recruiting for one (1) Community Coordinator, to function as a Model Center Project Coordinator, who will:
  
  

* Plan and monitor the implementation, expansion, and overall organization of community-based Model Job Centers by assisting Centers in developing mechanisms to track accountability and progress therein. Assist FIA data reporting staff in the development of new performance indicators and management tools for the purpose of maximizing the Center’s operational performance and ability to achieve Agency goal of moving cash assistance recipients toward economic independence.

  

* Prepare daily evaluation reports on operations of community-based Model Job Centers by collecting data from the Paperless Office System (POS), Welfare Management System (WMS) and Model Center Numbering and Identification Queue (MONIQ) applications and formulating it into reports to identify problematic issues and communicate potential and/or newly discovered negative trends to the Deputy Commissioner for Operations and Center management. Recommends the corrective course of action as needed.

  

* Coordinate with the Division of Job Support Services by participating in intra agency meetings to facilitate the opening and development of community-based Model Job Centers and acts on any decisions made during those meetings in collaboration with the appropriate FIA departments and Community Based Organizations.

  

* Perform analyses and review program plans using various management tools to monitor the community-based Model Center implementation effort, staff performance and program outcomes. Reports findings to the Deputy Commissioner for Operations, Center management, and trainers, as needed.

  

* Collaborate with FIA Office of Policy, Procedures and Training to identify problem areas or issues that warrant further analysis, training, and corrective action. Work closely with the appropriate entities on various projects, including, but not limited to systems implementation, introduction and revision of policies, procedures, and work processes, as related to community-based Model Job Centers and Food Stamp Offices.

  

* Attend HRA’s Office of Community and Constituent Affairs monthly meetings to share FIA's operations information and provide program updates, as appropriate.

  

* Assist in organizing the Queens annual Community Awareness Day event, which provides health, financial and employment information to the communities of all the five boroughs of New York City by interacting with vendors from many Community Based Organizations.

jobs.description:
We invite you to review our current business services professionals openings to learn about the opportunities available across the firm.

**About Us**

Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP has forged a reputation as one of the most prestigious law firms in the world. Relying on innovation, intellect, teamwork and tenacity, our lawyers deliver the highest quality advice and novel solutions to our clients’ legal issues. We are known for handling the most complex transactions, litigation/controversy issues, and regulatory matters, as well as for the strong partnerships we build with clients and each other. Our attorneys, who reflect a broad range of experiences and perspectives, work together seamlessly across 50-plus practices and 21 offices in the world’s major financial centers.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking a **Legal Technology Project Coordinator** to join our Firm. This position will be based in our New York office (hybrid).

**Position Overview**

Manage all aspects of discovery in litigation and regulatory matters using the Firm's legal technology solutions, providing consultative support and applying the Firm's electronic discovery best practices and project management strategies to manage cases efficiently and effectively. This position requires an in-depth understanding of the litigation life cycle, legal technology and electronic discovery.

**Responsibilities**

* Advise attorneys, paralegals and clients on electronic discovery best practices and consult on processes from collection through post-production tasks.
* Liaise with internal case teams, clients, vendors and the Legal Technology staff to support matters throughout all phases of discovery and offer recommendations about design, processes and workflows, including drafting project specifications for vendors.
* Maintain awareness of latest electronic discovery trends and be able to assess any impact they may have on Legal Technology workflows.
* Clearly articulate potential risks and provide possible solutions regarding collection, processing, review and production. Identify issues to escalate to Legal Technology management team.
* Demonstrate a thorough understanding of the Firm's litigation support software as it pertains to hosting document reviews, preparing productions and performing advanced searches.
* Assist with vendor selection and engagement process in consultation with Legal Technology management and attorneys to ensure the Firm’s vendor engagement procedures are followed including execution of agreements and conducting of security assessments.
* Manage basic aspects of collection, including identification of all sources and locations of electronically stored information.
* Manage all aspects of data processing, including coordinating with processing vendors, tracking custodians reviewing search terms, providing date ranges, determining optimal deduplication methods and troubleshooting processing issues. Communicate detailed processing specifications and instructions to the vendor.
* Manage all aspects of review, including set-up and design of the review database; access permissions, managed review providers and third party vendors; and development of a workflow.
* Manage all aspects of document production preparation, including reviewing production specifications with attorneys for best practices and strategic considerations; insuring productions are consistent and conform to any subpoenas, ESI protocols, joint defense agreements, etc.; running full quality control checks against any proposed production sets in coordination with the Paralegal Discovery Team and working with attorneys to resolve any issues found; and coordinating timing and technical resources with Legal Technology Data Specialists to ensure deadlines are met.
* Conduct quality check on final production volumes and media, including productions prepared by external vendors.
* Manage all aspects of post-production database work, including advising case teams on using databases to create privilege logs, setting up process for deposition/interview preparation, set up process for identifying and reviewing potential trial exhibits including coordination with trial presentation personnel/vendor.
* Support case teams in use of Firm’s generative AI tools in consultation with Legal Technology department management.
* Effectively communicate and provide end-user support and customer service to partners, co-counsel, case teams and clients throughout all phases of litigation and regulatory matters.
* Track progress of projects by maintaining and updating project files and documentation. Update internal case teams and clients as needed.
* Review and verify vendor invoices to ensure costs are consistent with the work performed and with relevant matter budgets.
* Work with Legal Technology management to develop recommendations, proposals, plans, cost estimates, budgets, procedures and specifications for new matters.
* Demonstrate effective interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills to facilitate effective work relationships with others.
* Manage Firm resources responsibly.
* Complies with and understands Firm operation, policies and procedures.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Knowledge of relevant firm computer software programs (e.g., Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint), with the ability to learn new software and operating systems
* Understanding of all aspects of the EDRM and of electronic discovery best practices, trends and techniques
* Understanding of analytics software, technology assisted review and workflows
* Familiarity with various electronic discovery platforms, including Relativity
* Understanding of basic litigation processes, including trial procedures
* Demonstrates effective interpersonal and communication skills, both verbally and in writing
* Demonstrates close attention to detail
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, organizational, and planning skills
* Strong project management skills

**About America On Tech:**

America On Tech (AOT) is a national nonprofit preparing the next generation of technology leaders from underestimated communities. Since 2014, AOT has provided no-cost tech education and workforce training to students in NYC, LA, Miami, and Atlanta. AOT equips young people with in-demand skills in AI, Web Development, Data Science, and more, creating pathways to higher education and careers. Learn more at www.americaontech.org.

**About the Apple Ecosystem and Swift Training Program**

The Apple Ecosystem and Swift Training Program is a flagship collaboration between America On Tech (AOT), Apple, the Hispanic Federation (HF), and CUNY. The program equips York College students and local community members with critical digital literacy and coding skills, creating pathways into technology careers.

In 2027, the program will train over 200 individuals across three learning tracks:

* **Apple Ecosystem Digital Literacy & Skills:** Short courses on foundational digital tools (e.g., Email, Numbers, Keynote, Pages, Resume Writing).
* **Intro to Swift Training:** Short courses to learn basic Swift skills and used as a recruitment tool for longer term SWIFT Training Course
* **NC3 Swift Certification Training:** A 96-hour NC3 Swift Certification Training preparing students for industry-recognized credentials.

All classes are held in-person at York College (94-20 Guy R. Brewer Blvd., Jamaica, NY 11451). Each class will include approximately 25 students, a mix of York College students and community members.

### **Position Overview**

America On Tech (AOT) is seeking a Program Coordinator to support the planning, operations, and execution of the Apple Ecosystem and Swift courses from February–December 2027, with onboarding beginning in January 2027. The coordinator will serve as the primary point of contact for students, instructors, and partners to ensure seamless program delivery. This role requires excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, as well as a strong commitment to supporting underestimated students in technology.

The Program Coordinator will work closely with AOT, HF, York College, and Apple staff to manage logistics, support student recruitment and classroom operations.

This role offers the opportunity to be at the forefront of innovative community technology education and to directly impact the career pathways of 200 underestimated students in technology.

* Program Monitoring & Reporting (20%)

**Why Join ADAPT?**

It's more than a job; it's a calling. It's where passion meets purpose. ADAPT Community Network, formerly United Cerebral Palsy (UCP) of NYC provides a multitude of services to people with developmental disabilities. At ADAPT, we are 3,000 strong, and it takes every one of us to empower the lives of the people we support. With caring and great resources at hand, we know what it takes to help people live fuller, happier, healthier lives. Our employees show their commitment to the people we support every day, and we all deliver on our promise to provide innovative and comprehensive services to individuals with developmental disabilities.

For your next career move, apply with us at ADAPT Community Network! Wherever you work among our many locations around New York City, ADAPT offers paid training, competitive benefits, and we foster a team culture of learning, support, collaboration and career growth.

Under the general direction of the program director or designee, the Residence Program Specialist is responsible for supporting the care, development, and independence of individuals living in an ADAPT Community Network residential facility. #### **Workflow Tracking & Operational Support**

Simon & Schuster is a global leader in general interest publishing, dedicated to providing the best in fiction and nonfiction for readers of all ages, and in all printed, digital and audio formats. Its distinguished roster of authors includes many of the world's most popular and widely recognized writers, and winners of the most prestigious literary honors and awards. It is home to numerous well-known imprints and divisions such as Simon & Schuster, Scribner, Atria Books, Gallery Books, Pocket Books, Adams Media, Simon & Schuster Children's Publishing and Simon & Schuster Audio and international companies in Australia, Canada, India and the United Kingdom, and proudly brings the works of its authors to readers in more than 200 countries and territories. For more information visit our website at www.simonandschuster.com.
  
  
Simon Maverick, a division of Simon & Schuster, is looking for a Marketing Coordinator to join our imprint which is dedicated to publishing a large list of audiobooks and select print titles primarily originating from independent and self-published authors. Our goal is to introduce both new and established voices on the independent scene to our rapidly growing list, merging the entrepreneurial spirit of these writers with the unsurpassed resources and distribution of Simon & Schuster. We are looking for a someone who has an entrepreneurial “start-up” mentality, eager to join an expanding imprint with the goal of merging the best of traditional publishing with the ever-changing literary marketplace.
  
You will collaborate closely with the marketing, publicity, and editorial teams to promote the Maverick publishing pipeline, and ensure the successful lifecycle of each title, from acquisition to publication and beyond. This role requires a publishing professional who is detail-oriented, fastidious in nature, creative and eager to find outside-the-box ways to promote our books but also comfortable using data analysis, all with an eye on making sure our books are best positioned for maximum success in the marketplace.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Develop and execute marketing campaigns across digital, retail, and social channels for a robust audiobook list with occasional print publications.
* Collaborate with the marketing team, as well as publicity and editorial, to build and execute comprehensive preorder, launch, and post-launch plans.
* Content creation with an emphasis on graphic design, with an ability to create lively social media posts, animated trailers, and a diverse set of digital assets incorporating graphic and audio components.
* Foster brand awareness and audience growth through targeted outreach.
* Assist in maintaining a robust network of influencers on both a macro and micro level, and working with marketing team on imprint newsletter
* Ability to work directly with a large roster of authors, agents, and proprietors to coordinate promotional schedules and opportunities.
* Coordinate with the publicity team to ensure titles have proper promotions beginning prior to release, while maintaining consumer awareness through the lifespan of the book.
* Assist in reviewing early access requests on Netgalley as well as fulfilling in person mailings for audio and print promotional campaigns.

**Qualifications:**  

* 3-5 years of experience in digital marketing and/or book publishing.
* A familiarity of the audiobook space and audience as well as being an audiobook listener is a plus.
* Proven track record of successful digital marketing campaigns and/or graphic design work
* Strong understanding how to create marketing content that both drives awareness and engagement.
* Knowledge of the independent or non-traditional literary scene is a plus, as is a knowledge of the commercial genre fiction landscape.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines with ease.
* Comfort with data analytics tools and dashboards to measure performance.
* Proficiency in Canva and Photoshop, as well as video editing software such as Premiere or Filmora
* A working knowledge of various social media platforms including but not limited to Instagram, TikTok, and Threads, as well as scheduling software, and strong general computer skills

**APPLY**
---------

  

Cornell University welcomes candidates for the position of **Administrative Coordinator, University Major Gifts** in our Alumni Affairs and Development division, based in New York City. This role presents an exceptional opportunity to contribute to the university's advancement efforts.

  
  

**Position Summary**

The Administrative Coordinator supports four to six University Major Gift Officers and plays an integral role in the work of the University Major Gifts team. The position coordinates fundraising data and reporting, donor acknowledgments and correspondence, work planning, travel, and expenses. The Administrative Coordinator also oversees the day-to-day operations of the New York City office, coordinates meetings and visits, and supports accurate budget tracking and reconciliation.

Key Responsibilities

* Provide comprehensive administrative and fundraising support to four to six University Major Gift Officers.

* Coordinate contact reports, visit requests, prospect stages, gift solicitations, work plans, travel, expenses, and other fundraising information.

* Draft and coordinate presidential and dean’s acknowledgments and other personalized donor correspondence; proofread proposals, reports, and related materials.

* Gather, analyze, and format fundraising information and reports for gift officers and department leadership.

* Monitor University Major Gifts budgets, process and track expenses, reconcile accounts, maintain accurate financial records, and investigate discrepancies.

* Coordinate the daily operations of the New York City office, including supplies, mail, meeting spaces, audiovisual and technology support, building services, and **in-person suppor**t for key events and visits from university leaders and other guests.

  

**About Alumni Affairs and Development**

At Cornell Alumni Affairs and Development, we connect alumni, parents, and friends with opportunities to make a meaningful difference at Cornell and beyond. Our success is built on the strength of relationships, a commitment to excellence, and a culture of collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and continuous learning. As one of higher education's leading fundraising and engagement organizations, we recently completed a record-setting campaign that engaged more than 221K alumni and raised $6.7 billion. Joining our team means growing your career alongside supportive, mission-driven, and high-performing colleagues while helping shape Cornell's future.

  

**What We Need**

* An associate’s degree and two to four years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

* Exceptional attention to detail, with strong organizational, project-management, and time-management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including strong proofreading abilities and careful attention to tone, accuracy, and presentation.

* Strong interpersonal and customer-service skills, with the ability to build positive relationships with donors, alumni, faculty, staff, and other stakeholders.

* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook; demonstrated ability to learn new systems quickly; and experience coordinating meetings, events, and related technology or audiovisual logistics.
  

  

**It Would Be a Bonus if You Have Any of the Following**

* Experience working in fundraising, advancement, higher education, or a related field, with knowledge of fundraising principles and systems.

* Experience with budget tracking, expense reconciliation, account review, or related financial coordination.

* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.
  

  

**Work Location**

* This position is eligible for a **hybrid-variable** work arrangement. Employees typically perform this role remotely up to 2 days per week and in-person 3 days per week. In office workdays may vary based on departmental and operational needs. The university reserves the right to modify, suspend, revoke or terminate the hybrid work arrangement at any time.
  

  

**Rewards and Benefits**

* Cornell receives national recognition as an award-winning workplace for our health, wellbeing, and sustainability.
* Our benefits programs include comprehensive health care options, generous retirement contributions, access to wellness programs, and employee discounts with local and national retail brands. We invite you to follow this link to get more information about our benefits: Understand Your Benefits | Working at Cornell.
* Our leave provisions include health and personal leave, three weeks of vacation and 13 holidays: Martin Luther King, Jr. Day, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and the day after, and an end of the year winter break from December 25-January 1. To offer greater flexibility for observing faiths and traditions we also offer two additional floating holidays. Learn more about our generous leave provisions: Holiday and Accrued Time Off | Working at Cornell
* Cornell's impressive educational benefits include tuition-free Extramural Study and Employee Degree Program, tuition aid for external education, and Cornell Children's Tuition Assistance Program. Learn more about our extensive educational benefits: Education Benefits | Working at Cornell
* Follow this link to learn more about the Total Rewards of Working at Cornell: Total Rewards | Working at Cornell.

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator (Workforce Development)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

**The Administrative Coordinator provides program administration, participant records, attendance tracking, data management and reporting support for TCAH’s Workforce Development Department, working closely with program leadership, the Case Worker, the Job Developer, instructors and worksite supervisors. This is an administrative and compliance support role; it does not include case management, eligibility determinations or independent approval authority.**

**TCAP / Venture VI is the primary assignment (approximately 70% of workload), with ongoing YEP support (approximately 30%), including Green Teens, Green Teens Workforce, Culinary Arts and Warehouse training. Percentages are approximate annual allocations and may shift with seasonal demand, including the summer SYEP peak, and approved funding.**

**Responsibilities**

**1. Program Administration & Coordination**

* **Maintain program calendars, staff and training schedules, participant appointments and room or site reservations.**
* **Prepare agendas, sign-in sheets, correspondence and forms; record meeting notes and track action items.**
* **Coordinate logistics for orientations, workshops, trainings and hiring events; route calls, referrals and inquiries to appropriate staff.**

**2. Participant Records & File Management**

* **Schedule intake appointments, prepare packets, and collect, scan and log participant documents for Case Worker verification.**
* **Maintain complete, confidential electronic and paper files, rosters, cohort lists and exit records, shared only with authorized staff.**
* **Review files at least monthly for missing signatures, incomplete fields or expired documents and notify the assigned Case Worker.**

**3. Attendance, Data Entry & Quality Review**

* **Enter attendance and countable participation hours from source records supplied by training and worksite supervisors; flag missing or inconsistent records.**
* **Enter and update participant, service and outcome data in Salesforce and other approved systems, using source data from the Case Worker and Job Developer.**
* **Run routine quality checks for missing, duplicate or inconsistent entries and return discrepancies to the original author; gather hours and wage documents for Payroll/Accounting.**

**4. Reporting, Deadlines & Compliance Support**

* **Track and issue alerts for 30-day SNAP eligibility verification, consent renewals and 30- and 90-day retention milestones.**
* **Prepare the weekly operations dashboard and compile data for monthly KPI, quarterly and annual program reports.**
* **Organize employment verification, supportive service and reimbursement documentation for review, monitoring and audits; flag incomplete records or potential duplicate assistance.**

**5. TCAP and YEP Program Coverage**

* **TCAP / Venture VI (approximately 70%): maintain referral logs, enrollment documents, rosters, attendance, hours and retention trackers; schedule orientations, workshops, training and employer events; check employment start documentation for completeness.**
* **YEP (approximately 30%): maintain rosters, attendance and training-progress records for youth ages 14–24 and prepare YEP performance data.**
* **Seasonal SYEP: support rosters, hours, outcome records, closeout and youth event logistics (scheduled and evaluated separately from the annual allocation).**

**6. Communication & Collaboration**

* **Work with program leadership, the Case Worker, Job Developer, instructors, Benefits Access, Finance, Contracts and Compliance; refer case management or eligibility questions to appropriate staff.**
* **Route payroll, reimbursements, supportive services and record corrections to designated approvers; accuracy of case content remains with its author.**
* **Attend staff meetings and trainings, and perform other related administrative duties as assigned.**

**Qualifications**

* **High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree in business administration, office administration, human services or a related field preferred. Degree preferred.**
* **At least two years of administrative, program coordination, data entry or office support experience; nonprofit, workforce or social services experience preferred.**
* **Strong organization, attention to detail and written and verbal communication skills; ability to handle confidential information responsibly.**
* **Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); Google Workspace and Salesforce or other CRM experience preferred.**
* **Familiarity with DYCD, WIOA, SNAP E&T, OTDA or HRA requirements, and additional language skills relevant to TCAH communities, preferred.**

**Schedule and Working Conditions**

**Full-time, primarily on-site at assigned TCAH locations and partner sites, with occasional evening or weekend work for program activities and events. Summer months may bring additional workload from seasonal youth programs. Any overtime for nonexempt staff requires advance approval; all hours worked must be recorded and paid as required by law.**

**Performance Expectations**

**Performance will be reviewed against monthly file reviews, with missing or expired items flagged within 2 business days; at least 95% data-entry accuracy on supervisor spot checks; attendance and hours entered within 2 business days, and other data within 3 business days, of receipt; deadline alerts issued at least 7 days before each due date; on-time weekly dashboard and report data; records organized for monitoring and audits; and administrative effort tracked across TCAP and YEP (approximately 70% / 30%).**

jobs.description:
Networking Partner Account Manager - NortheastThis role has been designated as ‘Remote/Teleworker’, which means you will primarily work from home.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

We are seeking an experienced **Networking Partner Account Manager** to join our HPE Networking Channel team, supporting our strategic national partner, Presidio. In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to the partner, developing mutually beneficial relationships aligned with HPE business priorities while driving revenue, profitability, and pipeline growth through joint business planning and data-driven sales efforts.

You will work closely with Presidio and HPE Networking teams to execute business strategies, identify growth opportunities, and position HPE Networking solutions to differentiate us from competitors. This role focuses on driving sales through the partner ecosystem, supporting enterprise customers across Commercial, State, Local and Education (SLED), and Federal markets.

***Responsibilities:***

* Provide resources and guidance to the national partner, Presidio, on where to play within emerging trends in the partner's ecosystem in alignment with HPE business priorities. Work with the partner to create a mutually beneficial plan for the future.
* Drive end-to-end HPE revenue, profitability, and pipeline by implementing joint business plans and data-driven sales efforts with the partner.
* Develop knowledge of partner priorities, industry trends, IT landscape, IT investment strategy, HPE priorities, and HPE technology, and communicate the value of networking portfolios and solutions to better differentiate HPE from competitors.
* Enact day-to-day HPE strategy, programs, and systems with and on behalf of the partner to assure accelerated financial outcomes and build partner loyalty to HPE.
* Tailor selling solutions to fit the needs of the partner's customer profile, including HPE products, services, and technology alliances, to achieve assigned quota.
* Work to ensure that partners are aware of and compliant with HPE's SBC requirements for partners, including applicable legal obligations.

***Education and Experience:***

* University or bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of selling experience.
* Located in the New York City, Boston, or broader Northeast region; and be willing to travel approximately 50% or more.

***Knowledge and Skills:***

Water Treatment Account Manager – Cooling Towers & Legionella

**NYC Metropolitan Area**

Water Engineering Services, Inc. (WES) is seeking an experienced, dependable, and highly organized **Water Treatment Account Manager** to join our growing team!

We are a privately owned water treatment and Legionella compliance company serving New Jersey, New York City, Delaware, and surrounding areas. We specialize in commercial and industrial water treatment, cooling tower maintenance, Legionella prevention, and regulatory compliance.

* Conduct chemical testing, water analysis, and necessary treatment adjustments.
* Inspect, troubleshoot, calibrate, and maintain chemical feed pumps, controllers, piping, and related equipment.
* Monitor cooling tower conditions and identify potential maintenance, mechanical, or water treatment issues.
* Assist with Legionella sampling, disinfection procedures, and compliance-related services.
* Maintain strong relationships with customers through regular communication and timely follow-up.
* Complete accurate and detailed service reports during each customer visit.
* Identify additional customer needs, recommend solutions, and communicate service opportunities.

* Assist with occasional cooling tower cleanings, equipment installations, and special projects.
* Follow all company safety procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.

Qualifications & Experience

**Required:**

* Previous hands-on experience servicing cooling towers and commercial or industrial water treatment systems.
* Strong understanding of water treatment practices, chemical testing, and treatment adjustments.
* Mechanical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and service water treatment equipment.
* Excellent time management and organizational skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple customer accounts and service schedules.
* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Ability to complete accurate reports and maintain detailed service records.
* Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record.
* Comfortable working in mechanical rooms, on rooftops, and in varying weather conditions.

**Preferred but Not Required:**

* Plumbing, pipefitting, or HVAC experience.
* Experience installing and repairing chemical feed pumps, controllers, and piping.
* Knowledge of Legionella prevention and cooling tower compliance requirements.
* Experience with boilers, closed-loop systems, and domestic water treatment.

What We're Looking For

Beyond technical experience, we are looking for someone who is:

* **Reliable and accountable:** Takes responsibility for assigned accounts, follows through, and consistently completes work.

* **Professional and personable:** Builds positive customer relationships and represents our company well.
* **Adaptable:** Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities may change.

Water Engineering Services is an established and growing company in an essential industry. We take pride in providing exceptional service, maintaining strong customer relationships, and delivering high-quality water treatment and Legionella compliance programs.

AI doesn't run in one place anymore. It runs in the browser tab, the desktop app, the agent your engineers kicked off, and the copilot embedded in the tools you already pay for. Harmonic Security governs all of it.

Our AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform sits on the device, inside the interaction, at the moment of action, reading what AI is actually doing (not just the traffic around it) and acting in under 200ms. Security teams get full visibility and control across every AI surface, including the agentic and MCP layer that traditional tools can't see. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down.

We're gaining serious traction at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel. As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build.

Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to the same standard. Everyone at Harmonic actively uses AI tools to do their best work, from research and writing to building processes and automating workflows. We expect every new hire to bring curiosity about AI and a willingness to use it to work smarter, faster, and more creatively. For some roles, that means tinkering and staying open to new tools. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager

### **Why We Need You**

Defense primes and top federal integrators run their proposals on GovEagle inside FedRAMP and AWS GovCloud, from our web app, Word, and SharePoint. We've grown 5x in revenue and 10x in daily users, and our customers expect answers in minutes: we hold ourselves to a first reply within 15 minutes. Fast, reliable help and real adoption are why customers renew and refer their peers.

We're adding a Customer Success Manager to own a book of accounts from kickoff through renewal. You'll make sure every team that buys GovEagle actually uses it: run onboarding and trainings, keep accounts healthy, and lead renewal and expansion conversations alongside sales. We want someone who holds a high bar for speed and follow-through, builds the playbooks the next CSM will use, and is comfortable creating urgency when a rollout stalls.

* **Own a book of accounts end to end.** Kickoff, onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion, with a clear plan for every account.
* **Respond fast.** First reply to customer messages in Teams and email within 15 minutes during business hours; resolve common issues the same day.
* **Run onboarding and trainings.** Coordinate SharePoint and SSO setup with customer IT teams, provision users, and lead trainings and office hours for proposal teams.
* **Drive renewals.** Track each account's goals, push for decisions, and partner with sales on renewal and expansion conversations.

* **Build the playbooks.** Onboarding checklists, training decks, help articles, and release notes that make every next account faster.
* **Escalate cleanly.** Reproduce issues, write tickets engineers can act on right away, and close the loop with the customer.
* **Be the voice of the customer.** Bring patterns in feedback and requests back to product and engineering.

* 2 to 5 years in customer success, account management, or implementation at a B2B software company, ideally a fast-growing startup. Or proposal, capture, or BD experience at a government contractor and a strong pull toward software.
* A track record of owning outcomes: renewals, adoption, or pilots you drove to a result.
* Fast and organized: you answer quickly, follow up without being asked, and keep every commitment visible.
* Comfortable with direct conversations: you can push a customer on timelines, usage, and next steps while keeping the relationship strong.
* A clear communicator who can run a training for a room of proposal managers.
* Tech-savvy and quick with new tools; Microsoft 365 and SharePoint experience is a plus.
* You use AI tools every day to work faster, and you know where not to trust them.
* U.S. citizen (required): our customers work in environments subject to export controls.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
Hawksmoor is a British steakhouse group, currently ranked No. 2 in the world among multi-site steakhouse groups by the World's 101 Best Steak Restaurants awards. We have three restaurants in the US: New York, Boston and Chicago, and this role owns the organic social media strategy across all of them, working alongside our Senior Group Content and Social Strategy Lead.

Our growth in the US rests on the same obsession that built the brand in the UK: real sourcing, real cooking, and a genuine point of view, carried through everything from the menu to the media we put out. This role is responsible for turning that into a considered, confident organic social strategy that builds Hawksmoor's reputation across three major US markets, and then for executing it hands-on, building the strategy and creating the content that brings it to life, in close partnership with our UK-based brand marketing team.

Key Responsibilities:

*Strategy & Planning*

* Collaborate with the Senior Group Content and Social Strategy Lead to develop and present the U.S. organic social media strategy in line with Hawksmoor’s business objectives and marketing calendar.
* Create and maintain monthly and quarterly social media plans for U.S. restaurants, aligned with wider business activity and culturally relevant moments.
* Act as the primary lead for Hawksmoor’s social media presence in the U.S., while working closely with the broader marketing team to ensure consistency of tone and brand messaging across regions.
* Build and present the US organic social strategy with the Group Senior Content Manager, tying every plan back to Hawksmoor's business objectives and marketing calendar.
* Turn brand plans and business goals into monthly and quarterly social plans for all three US restaurants, timed to wider business activity and moments that actually matter to our audience.
* Own the US social presence day to day, working with the wider marketing team to keep tone and message consistent across the UK and US.

*Content & Scheduling*

* Manage day-to-day channel activity, including community management, across all platforms for the US market
* Ensure cohesion between social media activity and wider marketing channels
* Proactively introduce creative social campaigns tied to brand activity, business objectives and cultural moments
* Brief and collaborate with internal teams and external partners as required
* Educate and upskill the wider marketing team on social media trends and platform best practice
* Know which content works on which platform for which audience, and plan accordingly rather than posting the same thing everywhere.
* Plan and schedule daily activity so campaigns land on time and stay relevant.

*Community & Engagement*

* Build genuine community, not just reply to comments and DMs on time, though that matters too. The goal is people who follow because they feel part of something.
* Build relationships with local influencers, creators and partners who fit the brand, to extend reach in each city.
* Spot opportunities for co-creation, user-generated content and local partnerships.

*Insights & Performance*

* Track performance and use the data to sharpen content, not just to report on it.
* Report regularly on activity and results, and use what you learn to adjust strategy.
* Stay ahead of platform and algorithm changes, and know what's worth acting on versus what's just noise.

Requirements:

* 3–5 years' proven experience managing social media across multiple channels and content types, ideally in hospitality, food & beverage, lifestyle or another premium, consumer-facing brand.
* Hands-on, proven experience managing Facebook, Instagram, TikTok end-to-end with a track record of managing high-volume channels with large followings.
* A track record of turning brand plans and business objectives into organic social strategy that actually delivers.
* Real platform and audience expertise: you know what content works on which platform for which audience
* Exceptional attention to detail, the kind that shows up in every caption, crop and post time.
* A quality-first instinct rather than a trend-chasing one. Our guest is 35+ and discerning; we want someone who can build content with real craft and restraint, not something that only works because it's this week's trend.
* Experience building community and engagement, not just managing it. Growing genuine audience connection rather than just responding to comments and messages.
* Sharp instincts for algorithm shifts, platform changes and emerging opportunities, and the initiative to act on them early.
* Content / asset creation skills a bonus but not necessity (Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, CapCut or similar).
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with real command of tone and brand voice.
* Comfortable in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities, which is normal in hospitality, and able to reprioritize without losing quality.
* Highly organized, confident managing your own timeline across time zones with the UK team.
* Pride in the work: every post represents the whole restaurant, and you treat it that way.
* Willingness to travel semi-regularly between New York, Boston and Chicago.

Independent B2B Security Sales Representative (Commission Only)

**100% Commission-Based | NY, NJ, Tri-State Area & Surrounding Markets | Flexible Schedule**

About SafeZone24

SafeZone24 is an established commercial security systems integrator with over 25 years of industry experience. We specialize in professional video surveillance (CCTV), access control, intrusion alarms, intercom systems, remote monitoring, and integrated security solutions.

We serve commercial properties, real estate developers, property management companies, construction firms, schools, houses of worship, community organizations, and other institutions throughout New York, New Jersey, the Tri-State region, and surrounding markets.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, self-motivated B2B Sales Representative or Business Development Professional who knows how to identify opportunities, build relationships, and bring in new projects.

This opportunity is ideal for someone with existing connections in commercial real estate, construction, property management, facilities management, or the security industry.

You focus on bringing in business. SafeZone24 provides the technical expertise, system design, project estimating, installation, and ongoing support.

Independent Contractor Opportunity

This opportunity is intended for an independent sales professional who operates their own business, controls their schedule and prospecting methods, and may represent other companies.

No daily office attendance is required. The representative independently develops business opportunities and coordinates with SafeZone24 when qualified projects are identified.

The relationship is intended to be governed by a written independent sales agreement, subject to applicable law.

Responsibilities

* Independently identify and pursue new commercial and institutional clients.
* Build relationships with property owners, developers, contractors, facility managers, and decision-makers.
* Generate qualified project opportunities through networking, outreach, and existing professional connections.
* Arrange client meetings and coordinate with our technical team.
* Follow up on proposals and help convert opportunities into signed projects.
* Develop long-term relationships that generate repeat business.
* Pursue business opportunities throughout New York, New Jersey, the Tri-State region, and surrounding markets.

Compensation

**This is a 100% commission-based opportunity with no guaranteed base salary.**

* Earn competitive commissions on qualifying new business you personally generate.
* Commissions are calculated based on eligible customer payments actually collected by SafeZone24.
* For projects paid in installments, commissions are calculated proportionally as eligible payments are received.
* No commission is paid merely for introductions, meetings, or proposals.
* Commission percentages, eligibility, earning and payment terms, and any adjustments will be defined in a written agreement compliant with applicable law.
* There is no guaranteed annual income. Earnings depend on successful business generation and customer collections.

Qualifications

* Demonstrated experience in B2B sales, business development, or commercial account acquisition.
* Ability to independently prospect, develop relationships, and generate qualified opportunities.
* Experience in security systems, low-voltage technology, construction, commercial real estate, or related industries strongly preferred.
* Existing relationships with commercial property owners, developers, contractors, or facility managers are a significant advantage.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to attend client meetings and site visits throughout the Tri-State region and surrounding markets.

Why Partner With SafeZone24?

* Established company with 25+ years of industry experience.
* Broad portfolio of commercial and institutional security solutions.
* Professional technical team handling design, estimating, installation, and service.
* Opportunity to generate business across multiple markets and industries.
* Freedom to independently manage your schedule and business-development activities.
* Performance-based earning potential tied to successful projects.

**If you have the industry connections, sales experience, and drive to bring in commercial projects, we'd like to hear from you.**

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Application Question(s):

* Are you interested in a 100% commission-based B2B sales opportunity with no guaranteed base salary, where commissions are paid on qualifying business after SafeZone24 receives payment from the customer?
* Have you independently generated and closed B2B sales opportunities? If yes, briefly describe the industries you worked in, how you found customers, and the types or approximate values of projects you closed.
* Do you currently have professional relationships with commercial property owners, real estate developers, general contractors, property managers, facility managers, or other decision-makers who may need security systems? If yes, which industries and types of contacts?
* If selected, how would you approach generating new commercial security projects for SafeZone24 during your first 30–60 days? Please briefly describe your prospecting strategy and how you would reach potential customers.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, Corporate Business Development
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Corporate Business Development (CorpBD) team at Amazon is looking for an Executive Assistant to support three Directors. CorpBD works with business leaders across Amazon to identify, negotiate, and manage partnerships that improve customer experience and support the company's long-term strategic vision.
  
  
As an Executive Assistant on this global team, you will manage complex calendars, coordinate domestic and international travel, plan events, and serve as a trusted point of contact between your leaders and stakeholders across the organization. You will bring strong organizational skills and sound judgment to a fast-paced environment where your contributions directly impact leadership effectiveness and team morale.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Manage complex calendars and scheduling for three Directors, balancing competing priorities with professionalism and discretion.
* Plan and execute events of varying scale, including team off-sites, staff meetings, and organizational gatherings, while coordinating logistics with stakeholders.
* Coordinate cost-effective domestic and international travel arrangements, creating detailed itineraries that account for time zone transitions and ground transportation.
* Prepare and curate content on behalf of leaders in partnership with key stakeholders, including meeting agendas, correspondence, and presentations, while handling confidential information with care.
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and leverage productivity tools — including generative AI where appropriate — to increase efficiency and quality of support.

  
A day in the life  
Your morning starts with a review of emails and calendar updates, adjusting schedules across time zones and confirming the day's priorities with your Directors. From there, you might finalize travel plans for an upcoming trip, pull together an agenda for a cross-team meeting, or troubleshoot a last-minute scheduling conflict. You serve as a reliable point of communication throughout the day, connecting your leaders with the right people and information when it matters.  
  
About the team  
CorpBD is a centralized function within Amazon's Corporate Business Development organization, working horizontally across the company's businesses. The team focuses on evaluating and structuring non-standard or first-of-their-kind deals, centralizing strategic partnerships, and providing strategic advisory support to internal teams. With roughly 70 employees globally, you will collaborate with colleagues across geographies and partner closely with other executive assistants, recruiting, facilities, and human resources teams.
