**Job Title:** Project Coordinator

**Company:** Loenbro, LLC  
**Business Unit/Department:** Southeast
  
**Location:** Douglas, GA/ On-site  
**Reports to:** Project Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**FLSA Classification:** Non-Exempt

**About Loenbro**

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

  

**At Loenbro, we don't just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose.** Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

  

**Job Summary**

The Field Project Coordinator is responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, execution, and completion of field-based projects. This role serves as a critical liaison between project managers, field personnel, subcontractors, clients, and vendors to ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with company quality standards.

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**

  

**Project Coordination**

* Assist Project Managers with the planning, scheduling, and execution of field projects.
* Coordinate project activities, resources, equipment, and personnel.
* Monitor project schedules and communicate progress updates to stakeholders.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, and deadlines.
* Support project startups, mobilization, and closeout activities.

**Field Operations Support**

* Conduct site visits to monitor project progress and ensure compliance with project specifications.
* Coordinate field crews, subcontractors, and vendors to maintain workflow efficiency.
* Ensure field activities are completed in accordance with safety regulations and company procedures.
* Assist with resolving field-related issues and identifying corrective actions.
* Maintain accurate records of site activities, labor hours, and equipment utilization.

**Documentation & Reporting**

* Prepare and maintain project documentation including daily reports, schedules, change orders, permits, and project logs.
* Track project costs, purchase orders, and invoices.
* Generate status reports for project managers and leadership teams.
* Ensure all project records are organized and updated throughout the project lifecycle.

**Client & Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as a point of contact for customers, contractors, vendors, and internal teams.
* Facilitate project meetings and document meeting minutes and action items.
* Communicate schedule changes, project updates, and field conditions to stakeholders.
* Build and maintain positive working relationships with clients and project partners.

**Safety & Compliance**

* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure adherence to OSHA and company safety requirements.
* Assist with job hazard analyses, site inspections, and safety audits.
* Verify compliance with contractual requirements, permits, and regulatory standards.
* Report and document incidents, near misses, and safety concerns.

**Skills**

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams.
* Experience with project management software is preferred.
* Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in fast-paced field environments.

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

  

* Associate's degree in construction management, Engineering, Project Management, Business, or a related field preferred.
* Equivalent field experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.

* 2+ years of project coordination, construction, industrial, utilities, telecommunications, or related field experience preferred.
* Experience supporting field operations and managing project documentation.
* Familiarity with subcontractor coordination and project scheduling.

  

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  

**Work Environment:**

  

* Ability to travel to project sites as needed.
* Ability to work both in office and field environments.
* Occasional lifting of up to 25 pounds.
* Ability to walk construction or industrial sites and work outdoors in varying weather conditions.

*This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.*

**Benefits**

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance

jobs.description:
**Historic Oakland Foundation (HOF) is a 501(c)3 nonprofit founded in 1976 as the “friends of” group for Oakland Cemetery. Our mission is to partner with the City of Atlanta to preserve, restore, enhance, and share Oakland Cemetery with the public.**

The **Program Coordinator** provides support for HOF’s public tour program, signature special events, community programs, and volunteers. The Program Coordinator reports to the Senior Director of Programs and Volunteers.

This is a full-time position. This position will work some weekdays (onsite and/or hybrid as needed) and onsite at least four full weekend days a month, 9 am – 5 pm, with some additional nights and weekends during special events and programs.

**Role and Accountabilities**

* Respond to guest questions and inquiries regarding Oakland’s programs and events with a customer-service mindset that embraces HOF’s core values;
* Create and administer event pages for programs, special events, and tours in Veevart, HOF’s Salesforce ticketing platform;
* Support the day-to-day management of Historic Oakland Foundation’s tour program including scheduling tours and volunteer tour guides for the weekly overview and special topic tours, including:
* Coordinating group and school tours; receiving and responding to inquiries, booking tours, and scheduling tour guides;
* Working with the Marketing and Communications team to promote and grow the tour program;
* Monitor effectiveness and growth of the Historic Oakland Foundation tour program through surveys and data;
* Assist the Senior Director of Programs and Volunteers in supporting and coordinating onsite logistics before, during, and after special events and programs including set-up, load-in, day of event, load-out, and clean-up; special events including but not limited to Illumine, Run Like Hell 5k, Sunday in the Park ft. Tunes from the Tunes, Day of the Dead Festival, and Capturing the Spirit of Oakland Halloween tours, including working with outside contractors and vendors and organizing staff and volunteer scheduling;
* Collaborate with the rest of the Programming team to strategize, plan, coordinate, and lead new programs aligned with HOF’s Strategic Plan;
* Assist in managing HOF’s volunteer corps from recruitment and onboarding through stewardship of existing volunteers, including monthly orientations, organizing volunteer appreciation events, and working with other volunteer managers to set up and manage Salesforce volunteer campaigns and shifts;
* Assist in managing and analyzing volunteer data in Salesforce to help grow and maintain the volunteer corps;
* Provide administrative and/or logistical support for large group volunteer opportunities;
* Occasionally support the Director of Education and Youth Programs in program coordination and implementation;
* Conduct all work through the lens of elevating diversity, equity, inclusion, and access (DEIA), and work proactively to help support the organization through a sustained period of organizational change whereby DEIA becomes the default lens through which all organizational attitudes and actions are conducted;
* Must be available to work evenings and weekends, as needed, to ensure the successful development and implementation of all Historic Oakland Foundation activities, signature special events, and programs.

**Education and Experience**

* High School diploma. An associate or bachelor's degree is preferred.
* 1- 2 years of administrative or assistant experience is preferred

**Required Knowledge, Skills, Competencies**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication
* Customer service mindset
* Ability to work independently
* Strong attention to detail
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work with a diverse group of professionals
* Ability to work within a complex institution with all levels of leadership, staff, volunteers, members, and donors
* Flexible and works well under pressure and deadlines
* Curious, motivated, and willing to self-learn
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Programs
* Working knowledge of office equipment
* Self-starter with ability to multi-task
* Analytical abilities and aptitude in problem solving
* Must be available to work weekends at Oakland Cemetery and additional evening and weekend hours at special events and programs as needed
* Experience with Salesforce

The person in this position ascends/descends stairs to access office space and resources and may occasionally lift boxes and equipment up to 20 pounds.

**To Apply:**

Interested applicants should email their letter of interest and resume to careers@oaklandcemetery.com.

**Position Classification:**

This position is full-time, with an hourly rate between $19.00 - $22.00, with compensation commensurate with experience.

**Additional Information:**

The statements contained in this position description are not necessarily all-inclusive; additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned, and requirements may vary from time to time.

Professional business references and a background check will be required for all final applicants selected for a position. In accepting a position, it is understood that continued employment is contingent upon a satisfactory background check. The Department of Microbiology, Biochemistry, and Immunology at Morehouse School of Medicine is seeking a highly motivated and talented**Research Coordinator**to join Dr. Erica L. jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager – Americas South
jobs.description:
**Our company**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do**

You will be accountable for marketing’s contribution to pipeline for your region. You carry specific pipeline goals and delivering them is your priority. If it doesn't contribute directly to pipeline, we don't do it.

You will be the marketing partner that regional GTM teams turn to first. Working with sales leaders to develop the regional marketing plan, you will turn global programs into campaigns that are highly relevant to your accounts and show how Teradata can solve their problems. Your work accelerates the sales cycle, generates new pipeline from existing customers and new logos, and strengthens customer preference for Teradata’s solutions.

**What You'll Bring**

You own the outcome, not the activity. You judge your work by pipeline created, and treat event attendance, click rates, and even MQLs as signals, not the goal. When pipeline is behind plan, you flag it early, bring options, and change course.

You are a partner to sales, not an order taker. You start with the customer’s problem, not the product, and you choose the activity that makes selling easier over the one that only fills the calendar.

You ask why we do things the way we do, and you don’t settle for “that’s how it’s always been”. You challenge colleagues, from sales leaders to marketing teammates to your own manager, when you see a better way. You do it constructively and always focused on the outcome, and you welcome being challenged back. You try something different when the usual play stops working, share what you learned, and stop what isn’t working, even when it was your idea.

What you say will happen, happens: on time, with the follow-up planned and nobody chasing you. You give colleagues honest feedback and make the people around you better.

*Not for you if:* you measure success by events run or campaigns launched, you wait for a brief rather than help shape the plan, or you would rather perfect a plan than get it into market. It’s also not for you if follow-up, attribution, and reporting feel like someone else’s job.

*Essential Duties and Responsibilities*

Own marketing pipeline for Americas South

* Forecast and track pipeline contribution against your goals, and build the programs needed to close any gap
* Build the regional marketing plan with sales leaders leveraging global programs, localizing only where it moves pipeline and balancing existing customers with new logos
* Build strong working relationships with sales leaders and account teams, aligning programs to account priorities and deal progression, and agreeing priorities in regular pipeline conversations

Turn programs into pipeline

* Deliver cross-channel demand generation programs end-to-end, from planning and build through to execution and follow-up – every activity is part of a journey that leads toward measurable pipeline impact
* Execute ABM programs for named and cluster accounts, including buying committee mapping and account-level content, in platforms such as Influ2
* Be the marketing expert regional GTM teams rely on, keeping sales leaders, account teams, and SDRs briefed on what’s coming, what it means for their accounts, and what to do next
* Travel domestically and internationally to bring your programs to life in market, and stay close to the sales teams you support

Let the data decide

* Own reporting on full-funnel performance, pipeline, conversion, and ROI by program, account, and segment
* Move budget and effort toward what works and away from what doesn't, managing the regional calendar and budget

**Who You'll Work With**

* Day to day: regional sales leaders, account teams, and SDRs, staying close on pipeline and follow-up through regular conversations
* Regularly: your field marketing leader, Americas field marketing colleagues and the global demand generation and field marketing team

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor's degree
* At least 5 years in B2B marketing (field marketing, demand generation, or ABM), ideally in enterprise software, data, analytics, or AI
* A track record of delivering against pipeline or revenue goals that you can show in numbers
* Working proficiency in Salesforce, including campaign and pipeline reporting
* Hands-on ABM and demand generation experience, ideally with platforms such as Influ2 and Eloqua
* Experience as the marketing partner to a regional sales team, with confidence influencing sales leaders

**Why We Think You'll Love Teradata**

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
### **About us and why we’re hiring...**

RoadSync is revolutionizing the logistics industry with intelligent, simple, and innovative financial solutions. Our digital platform streamlines payment processes for warehouses, carriers, brokers, and repair/tow operators, dramatically reducing processing time and maximizing revenue collection.

We are seeking an Implementation Specialist to onboard and activate new customers. You’ll own the early customer journey for your assigned accounts—from kickoff to first transaction to full ramp—and ensure every customer is actively using the product, not just set up.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

##### **Onboarding & Activation**

* Manage onboarding for your assigned customers from deal close through first transaction, aiming to complete onboarding within the month.
* This position may require travel (35%) to see clients.
* Keep implementations moving by identifying blockers early, sequencing setup steps, and hitting activation milestones.
* Guide customers through configuration, training, and their first live transactions.
* Validate business requirements upfront so each implementation is scoped correctly.

##### **Ramp & Feature Adoption**

* Track customer transaction volume weekly and flag accounts falling behind the expected ramp.
* Drive adoption of revenue-generating features, including hardware and special promotions.
* Use implementation playbooks to move customers from basic setup to full platform use.

##### **Retention & Transition**

* Monitor customer health in your portfolio and raise at-risk accounts early.
* Hand off customers to Account Management with documented notes: active transactions, features adopted, and next steps.
* Work with the Account Management team to keep transitions warm and customers engaged after handoff.

##### **Process & Knowledge Sharing**

* Follow and contribute to documented processes, playbooks, and knowledge base articles.
* Meet team KPIs and SLAs, and take coaching and feedback from your manager.
* Suggest process improvements and share them with your manager and Revenue Operations.

##### **Communication & Collaboration**

* Give your manager regular updates on onboarding progress and at-risk accounts.
* Share clear, data-backed feedback with Product, RevOps, and Support when you see activation blockers or process friction.
* Escalate issues with context and a recommended path forward.

#### **Qualifications**

##### **Required**

* 1–3 years of experience in customer success, implementation, or onboarding within a SaaS or payments technology environment.
* Experience managing customer onboarding or implementation projects focused on time-to-value and activation.
* Ability to review data, spot at-risk accounts, and act on what you find.
* Comfortable using a CRM (HubSpot a plus) for tracking customers, health, and reporting.
* Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable working with customers and cross-functional teams.

##### **Preferred**

* Experience in logistics, payments, or fleet services.
* Familiarity with merchant processing, transaction-based revenue, or platform fee models.
* Experience deploying hardware (payment terminals, mobile devices) during onboarding.
* Experience contributing to implementation playbooks, knowledge bases, or customer training.

#### **Why you’ll love it here...**

RoadSync is a team of passionate professionals who care deeply about what we do and bring our best every day. We value being a diverse and inclusive team and company. In addition to joining an innovative and passionate team, you will get:

* Competitive compensation package and company equity awarded on day 1!
* Three weeks (15 working days) of PTO annually
* Medical, dental, and vision benefits, with premiums paid for employees
* Exposure to the inner workings of a growing company, including open, transparent communication within our team. You will know what is happening and why it matters.
* Hybrid office, Downtown Atlanta, Georgia

*RoadSync is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and an Affirmative Action Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, creed, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression, age, height, weight, veteran status, military obligations, pregnancy, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law. We're looking for a highly organized, motivated, and resourceful Executive Assistant & Real Estate Coordinator to work directly alongside the owner and help manage the day-to-day responsibilities of a busy real estate business.

**This is not your typical desk job.**

One day you might be preparing a home for the market, coordinating marketing materials, or organizing contracts. The next day you could be visiting properties, meeting contractors, managing schedules, or helping solve an unexpected issue.

We're looking for someone who enjoys variety, takes pride in getting things done, and doesn't need to be constantly told what to do next.

The ideal candidate is proactive, dependable, detail-oriented, comfortable with technology, and capable of managing multiple responsibilities independently.

Key Responsibilities

**Executive & Administrative Assistance**

* Manage the owner's calendar, appointments, scheduling, and reminders.
* Coordinate meetings, follow-ups, and day-to-day business activities.
* Organize documents, maintain records, and keep important deadlines on track.
* Research information, find solutions, and assist with miscellaneous business assignments.
* Handle occasional personal errands and appointments.
* Anticipate upcoming needs and proactively complete tasks without constant direction.

**Real Estate Listing & Transaction Coordination**

* Coordinate residential real estate listings from preparation through closing.
* Schedule photography, inspections, showings, and other property-related appointments.
* Create and coordinate listing brochures, flyers, social media materials, and other marketing content.
* Prepare and organize contracts, disclosures, and transaction documents for appropriate review and approval.
* Communicate with attorneys, lenders, inspectors, vendors, clients, and other parties.
* Track contract deadlines and ensure required paperwork is completed.
* Maintain accurate listing and transaction files.
* Assist with MLS-related administrative work as permitted by licensing requirements.

**Field Operations & Property Support**

* Visit residential properties throughout the Chicago suburbs.
* Install lockboxes and coordinate property access.
* Take property photos, document conditions, and report findings.
* Meet inspectors, photographers, contractors, and other service providers at properties.
* Complete property checks, supply runs, and miscellaneous field assignments.
* Support rental property operations through occasional property visits and supply coordination.
* Conduct showings or other licensed activities when properly licensed and authorized.

**Client Database & Marketing**

* Maintain and organize the client and prospect database.
* Help develop and execute approved past-client marketing and referral campaigns.
* Assist with client communications, follow-ups, and special events.
* Create marketing materials using modern technology and AI tools.
* Identify opportunities to improve client engagement and repeat business.

**Real Estate Investment Support**

* Assist with property research and comparable sales analysis.
* Support investment property acquisitions through administrative coordination and fieldwork.
* Help organize acquisition documents and property information.
* Opportunity to grow into additional acquisitions responsibilities based on performance, experience, and licensing.

What We're Looking For

**Required Qualifications**

* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and problem-solving abilities.
* Dependable, punctual, and accountable.
* Ability to independently prioritize and complete multiple tasks.
* Strong computer skills and familiarity with modern business software.
* Experience with or willingness to use AI tools to improve efficiency.
* Comfortable working in both an office and field environment.
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and willingness to travel locally.
* Ability to work primarily from our Glenview office and accommodate occasional evening or weekend assignments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous real estate, executive assistant, transaction coordination, or operations experience.
* Illinois real estate license, or willingness to obtain one.
* Experience with CRM software and task management systems.
* Familiarity with real estate contracts, listings, and transaction procedures.
* Experience with Canva, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar tools.
* Comfortable creating marketing materials and managing projects.

**We value initiative, intelligence, reliability, and attitude just as much as experience.**

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?

We are looking for someone who:

* Takes ownership of responsibilities from beginning to end.
* Anticipates what needs to happen instead of waiting for instructions.
* Follows through and communicates completion without being chased.
* Is comfortable juggling multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Enjoys solving problems and finding better ways to accomplish tasks.
* Takes pride in being dependable and helping a business run smoothly.
* Is flexible, positive, resourceful, and willing to jump in where needed.

Compensation & Benefits

* Annual salary of $50,000–$60,000, depending on experience and qualifications.
* Full-time W-2 employment.
* Vehicle allowance and applicable business expense reimbursement.

Job Description

Job Title: Sales Operations Coordinator

DESCRIPTION:

The Sales Operations Coordinator is a key member of the Sales Operations team, responsible for orchestrating complex sales processes, managing contract administration, and supporting cross-functional collaboration. This role combines advanced administrative expertise, process optimization, and project management to ensure seamless execution of sales activities and superior customer experience. The Sales Operations Coordinator will drive continuous improvement, and serve as a liaison between Sales, Logistics, Purchasing, Accounting, and other departments.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

Sales Process & Operations:

* Receive, review, and process purchase orders; collaborate with Sales Liaison and Sales Operations to resolve pending issues and ensure order accuracy.
* Allocate inventory and machines/models for incoming sales, maintaining up-to-date spreadsheets and ETA/cost updates.
* Oversee client engagement and outreach throughout the sales cycle, supporting machine sales and post-sale follow-up.
* Monitor sales and delivery reports and coordinate with Senior Sales Operations Coordinators on changes needed.
* Support project management by tracking deadlines, monitoring progress, and following up on outstanding issues.
* Ensure data integrity across ERP/Salesforce systems (Microsoft Dynamics AX preferred).
* Generate and submit back-order reports, support monthly, quarterly, and annual closings in collaboration with accounting.
* Support the GM of Sales Operations with special projects, contract reviews, and operational requests.
* Collaborate with regionals, direct sales, and dealers on inventory availability and order fulfillment.
* Coordinate with Logistics, Purchasing, Installations, and Accounting to support machine sales, inventory management, and service transfers.
* Support international shipping processes, including duty drawback, customs documentation, and logistics coordination.

Contract Management & Administration:

* Assist with preparation, review, and administration of subcontracts, vendor agreements, consultant agreements, NDAs, teaming agreements, purchase orders, MOUs, and inter-organization work transfers.
* Review contract documents for compliance (including FAR), notify management of new contracts, modifications, renewals, and critical actions.
* Maintain official subcontract/vendor/consultant files and distribute contract documentation as required.
* Respond to inquiries, provide reports containing requested contract data, and resolve day-to-day contract administration issues.
* Perform audits and support compliance measures for contract and sales operations.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

* Strong organizational, project, and time management skills.
* Advanced judgment, problem-solving, and proactive approach.
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize workload in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Business, or related field preferred.
* 5+ years’ experience in sales coordination, administration, or related roles.
* Demonstrated experience in contract management and sales operations.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

Job operates mainly indoors but exposed to generally consistent conditions, such as regulated air conditioning and heating. This job also works near a machinery showroom, which may generate some noises such as objects hitting the floor and creating a sound, forklift movement and occasional other short term noises.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

This job requires prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Repetitive use of the hands and typing are required. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

new_jobs.title: SLAAI Program Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Description:

**SUMMARY**

South LA All In (SLAAI) is a multi-year, coalition-driven initiative designed to address longstanding racial and socioeconomic inequities in South Los Angeles, with a focus on underserved communities east of the 110 Freeway.

SLAAI strengthens South Los Angeles through coordinated investments and partnerships in five priority areas: Good Jobs, Education, Housing Stability & Affordability, Access to Capital, and Social Infrastructure.

Reporting directly to the SLAAI Program Manager, the Program Coordinator provides day-to-day administrative and program coordination support across SLAAI initiatives. The position keeps programs organized, documented, and moving by maintaining accurate participant and partner records, coordinating logistics and communications, tracking milestones and performance data, administering surveys, and supporting timely grant and program reporting.

The Program Coordinator works closely with the SLAAI Director, Associate Director, Outreach & Engagement Manager, Outreach Coordinator, CRCD departments, community partners, and the Learning & Evaluation team. This is a coordination and implementation-support position and does not independently set program strategy, approve budgets, supervise staff, make final participant-selection decisions, or assume the direct-service responsibilities of case managers, coaches, or partner agencies.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Position roles and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
* **Program Coordination:** Maintain initiative workplans, calendars, milestone trackers, task lists, meeting schedules, and follow-up timelines across assigned SLAAI programs.
* **Meeting & Event Logistics:** Coordinate scheduling, invitations, registration, technology, materials, food, room setup, site tours, participant reminders, and other logistics for workshops, trainings, convenings, and community events.
* **Program Materials:** Prepare agendas, meeting packets, sign-in materials, presentations, resource guides, certificates, and other participant and partner documents.
* **Action Item Tracking:** Document decisions, action items, responsible parties, and deadlines; follow up to support timely completion and escalate implementation risks to the Program Manager
* **Data & Records Management:** Maintain complete, accurate, and current participant, partner, referral, attendance, service, training, and outcome records in approved systems, including SharePoint, Forstack, and initiative-specific trackers.
* **Performance Tracking:** Track enrollment, attendance, retention, training completion, referrals, service connections, exit outcomes, and other required performance indicators.
* **Survey Administration:** Coordinate pre-program, session-specific, and post-program surveys in partnership with the Learning & Evaluation team and track response completion.
* **Data Quality:** Review records for completeness, resolve routine discrepancies, and flag missing or inconsistent information before internal and external reporting deadlines.
* **Reporting Support:** Compile documentation, data summaries, success stories, and program files for quarterly and grant reporting led by the Program Manager.
* **File Management & Confidentiality:** Maintain organized, audit-ready electronic files in accordance with CRCD confidentiality, record-retention, and data-security requirements.
* **Participant & Partner Communication:** Provide timely, professional communication to participants, community-based organizations, faith-based institutions, facilitators, guest speakers, and program partners.
* **Enrollment & Onboarding Support:** Support application processing, eligibility-document collection, leadership authorizations, onboarding, and program completion documentation.
* **Engagement Follow-Up:** Track participant engagement and follow-up needs and coordinate with the appropriate outreach, program, or direct service staff when barriers arise.
* **Partner Database Management:** Maintain current contact information, participation history, program roles, referrals, and next steps for partners, facilitators, and guest speakers.
* **Post-Program Coordination:** Support follow-up visits, referrals, technical-assistance coordination, and documentation of participant or partner next steps.

**INITIATIVE-SPECIFIC PERFORMANCE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Good Jobs Network:** Document and track at least 90 youth and young adult referrals, ages 16–24, during the grant period.
* **Healthcare Career Pathways:** Track clinical and nonclinical participant enrollment, progress, and training completion.
* **Helping Families Thrive:** Maintain complete eligibility, enrollment, service, and outcome records for participating families.
* **CBO Capacity Building:** Maintain workshop attendance records and track completion of pre- and post-assessments.
* **SLAAI Capacity Building Bootcamp:** Document participation and completion of 60 hours of capacity building and technical assistance for 10 enrolled CBOs.
* **CRCD Thought Leadership:** Maintain records of conferences, presentations, audiences, topics, materials, and geographic reach.
* **Project Hope Bridge:** Maintain participant eligibility, referral, housing, service, workforce, subsidy, exit-planning, and outcome records.
* **South LA Is Home:** Maintain application, authorization, attendance, survey, partner, speaker, and next-step records for participating faith-based institutions.

**KEY PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS**

* Maintain complete and current required records for at least 95% of active participants and partners, with corrections completed by established reporting deadlines.
* Document attendance and participation for 100% of assigned workshops, convenings, trainings, and program sessions.
* Enter or update routine program data within five business days of receiving complete source documentation.
* Distribute assigned participant and partner communications by established deadlines

---------------

**THE COMMUNITY**

Idyllically located on the Pacific Coast just south of Los Angeles and adjacent to Orange County, Long Beach is a vibrant city of approximately 450K residents. Known for its diverse and inclusive community, Long Beach features a unique blend of urban sophistication, cultural richness, and coastal charm. The City encompasses about 51 square miles, offering an array of parks, beaches, and recreational opportunities. Residents enjoy mild climate year-round perfect for outdoor activities such as biking, running, water sports, and much more. Long Beach is home to world-class attractions including the Aquarium of the Pacific, the historic Queen Mary, and the annual IndyCar Acura Grand Prix of Long Beach. Long Beach will be the largest venue city for the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games.

Long Beach also boasts a thriving economy supported by industries such as aerospace, education, health services, manufacturing, tourism and professional services. With two advanced educational institutions, California State University Long Beach and Long Beach City College, and robust K-12 schools, the City is a hub for learning and innovation. Transportation options abound. The Long Beach and Metro transit systems along with the City’s own airport provide convenient access throughout the broader Southern California region. Long Beach is recognized as one of the nation’s most walkable and bike-friendly cities.

**CITY GOVERNMENT**

Long Beach operates as a charter city governed by an elected Mayor and nine City Council members elected by district. The City Manager, appointed by the Mayor and City Council, oversees the daily operations of 15 departments and an FY26 annual budget of approximately $3.7B. The City employs over 6,000 full-time and part-time staff; dedicated to providing exceptional public services with the vast majority being represented by eleven employee associations.

* City Departments
* Citywide FY26 Budget
* 2030 Strategic Vision
* Elevate ’28 Infrastructure Investment Plan

The City of Long Beach fosters an environment where every employee is celebrated for their individuality and unique talents they bring to their role. Reflecting the diversity of the community within the workforce is a key priority embraced at every level of the organization—from management to policycreation. City Leadership actively promotes equity and inclusion by partnering with staff and community stakeholders to advance fairness in all initiatives. Transparency remains a cornerstone of these efforts with demographic data, including workforce diversity and pay equity by race and gender, shared publicly to ensure accountability and progress.

**THE DEPARTMENT OF ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT & OPPORTUNITY**

The Department of Economic Development & Opportunity is an innovative department that leverages Federal, State, and City resources to generate growth in property, sales, and transient occupancy taxes that pay for services citywide. The Department continuously works to implement the recommendations of the Grow Long Beach Economic Blueprint. This comprehensive plan provides policy recommendations and will further Long Beach as an innovative ecosystem that lays a foundation for entrepreneurial success from business start-up to growth.

The Department has approximately 90 employees with five bureaus: Business Development, Business Operations, Real Estate Development, Waterfront Development, and Workforce Development. The Department's mission is to create economic opportunities for workers, investors, and entrepreneurs with an annual budget of over $31 million from eight different City funds.

To learn more about the Department visit:

* Department Website
* Department FY 26 Budget
* Grow Long Beach Initiative
* Bureau Website

The Community Program Specialist V (Administrative Services Supervisor) is an unclassified, at-will supervisory position that reports to the Workforce Development Officer and provides leadership and oversight for Data Management, Contracts, and Procurement.

This role is responsible for ensuring integrity, accuracy, and compliance of workforce program data across the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA) and other federal, state, and locally funded initiatives. It also oversees contract administration and procurement functions, including the development, monitoring, and compliance of program contracts and purchasing activities. The position plays a key role in strengthening performance accountability, driving continuous improvement, maintaining audit readiness, and advancing equitable service delivery.

This position supervisors a team of three staff—one Data Integrity Specialist, one Training and Contracts Coordinator, and one Contracts and Procurement Specialist, and serves as the lead authority for data governance, reporting systems, performance monitoring, and contracts and procurement functions in support of workforce development programs.

* Lead and supervise staff responsible for data management, contracts, and procurement, providing strategic direction, guidance, and performance oversight to ensure accurate and timely data reporting and effective contract and procurement administration across all workforce programs.
* Oversee and support the development, implementation, and performance monitoring of contracts and procurement activities, including training contracts and other program-related agreements

new_jobs.title: Executive Assistant & BD Associate
new_jobs.description:
Devoted Studios is a globally remote game development company specializing in Co-development, Porting, and End-to-End Art Production for the global gaming industry. We collaborate across time zones to support projects on all major platforms, engines and styles - from AAA titles to emerging technologies.

Our team includes world-class talents who bring deep expertise in external development, pipeline optimization, and creative problem-solving. Whether it's porting games to new systems, enhancing gameplay features, or crafting stunning visuals, Devoted Studios operates as a trusted, flexible extension of our partners' internal teams.

We are proud to be the development partner of choice for industry leaders such as:

* 2K
* Xbox
* Meta
* Obsidian Entertainment
* Turtle Rock Studios
* Gearbox Software

### **About the Role**

Our CEO is deeply involved in sales, partnerships, and running the company day-to-day. We're looking for someone based in Los Angeles who can work alongside her and help turn client conversations and opportunities into real execution across the company.

This is a hands-on, high-trust role. Much of the work involves coordinating internal teams, organizing proposals and deal materials, and ensuring follow-through after client discussions.

We are actively building AI-driven workflows across the company, and the right person will be excited about experimenting with AI tools, automation, and cloud systems while helping implement them across the organization.

### **Responsibilities**

**Sales & Client Partner**

* Act as the CEO’s right hand across the full sales cycle, from first conversation to signed deal and ongoing relationship, so she can focus on opening, closing and growing accounts.
* Keep the CEO’s pipeline moving: track every opportunity she’s involved in, own the next steps, and make sure no deal stalls for lack of follow-up.
* Turn the CEO’s client and partner conversations into structured action plans, and rally the right people across BD, production and pre-production to deliver proposals, estimates and materials on time.
* Prepare the CEO for client and partner meetings with sharp, research-backed briefs, and own follow-up afterwards.
* Build decks, documentation and materials for client, partner and contract conversations.
* Stay on top of video game industry news and bring the CEO opportunities, partners and market moves worth acting on.
* Keep the CRM accurate for every account the CEO touches, and report weekly on where each relationship and deal stands.
* Support BD trainings, initiatives and summits that grow the BD team.

**Conferences, Events & Community** (a creative, high-energy part of the role)

* Plan and run the CEO's conference presence end to end, including meeting schedules, materials, travel and logistics, and travel with the CEO when needed.
* Plan and execute company events, industry gatherings, mixers and community initiatives, with related marketing coordination and materials.
* Drive podcast organization and growth with Marketing, including guests, scheduling and production coordination.

**Running the CEO's World**

* Manage and prioritize the CEO's calendar, protect her time, and act as gatekeeper against low-value demands.
* Review and triage the CEO's email, draft replies, take over communications where appropriate, and surface only what needs her.
* Track the CEO's open items and personally chase them across departments, including documents, signatures, approvals and answers, until each one is closed.
* Keep a running tracker of open items and review it with the CEO weekly, so nothing lives in her head.

**In-Person Operations & CEO Co-Pilot**

* Handle everything that needs a person physically there: errands, appointments, home and life coordination, and other personal needs, so they don't pull the CEO's attention from running the company.
* Own the legwork on government and administrative filings, including IRS submissions, working with Finance on content and tracking every item to completion.
* Notice what needs handling and step in proactively, before being asked.
* Be a trusted, steady presence alongside the CEO and create the conditions for her to do her best work.

**Success in the First 30 Days**

* The CEO's calendar runs with no misses.
* Every client meeting has a brief before it and a follow-up within 24 hours.
* An open-items tracker is live and reviewed weekly.
* You own the plan for the next conference end to end.

  
**Requirements**

**Who We're Looking For**

* A driver and finisher who gets people moving, chases things down, and closes loops without being reminded.
* Writes everything down, tracks everything, and reports status before being asked.
* Thrives in a hands-on role that moves between client-facing work and personal support in the same day.
* Has experience as a project manager, producer, or executive assistant to a founder or talent.
* Comfortable working in spreadsheets, Google Workspace, and email-heavy coordination.
* Eager to experiment with AI tools, automation, and cloud systems in practical ways.
* Can coordinate stakeholders, hold people accountable to commitments, and keep work moving.
* Eligible to work in the United States.
* Available for occasional conference or event support.
* Game industry knowledge is a plus, not a requirement. You'll be trained in your first 30 days.
* Client-facing experience such as account coordination or event sales support is a plus.
* This role includes hands-on personal and administrative support. If that feels beneath you, this isn't your role.

  
**Benefits**

**Why join us? We offer:**

* 401k
* Healthcare
* Paid vacation
* Company closure in Summer and Christmas (1 week for both) as additional paid time off

* **Qualify with rigour:** Run sharp first conversations, qualify honestly, and hand off to the AE with context they can actually use. A meeting that shouldn't have been booked costs us more than a meeting we missed
* **Go multi-channel:** Email, LinkedIn, phone, and in person. You will pick up the phone
* **Work the room:** Book meetings around PMA, SAP Connect, TSIA, Ai4, and our executive dinner series — before, during, and after

--------------------

* **Path:** This is a clear on-ramp to an AE seat for someone who earns it

**Required Skills & Abilities**
-------------------------------

* **Outbound reps on the board:** 1–3 years in a BDR, SDR, or business development role. At least a year of genuine cold outbound — you've built lists, run sequences, and made the calls
* **Phone-ready:** You're not precious about cold calling, and you don't hide behind email
* **You can write:** A four-sentence email that a CTO actually answers is a real skill, and you have it, or you're obsessed with getting it
* **Technically curious:** You don't need an engineering background, but you should want to understand what an integration is, why it breaks, and why our customers care
* **High output, high coachability:** You take feedback in the morning and apply it that afternoon. You track your own numbers before anyone asks
* **Presence matters:** Based in the SF Bay Area and ready to collaborate in-office 3 days a week

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Hands-on with HubSpot, Clay, Sales Navigator, or AI-assisted prospecting tooling

**About Us**

Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP has forged a reputation as one of the most prestigious law firms in the world. Relying on innovation, intellect, teamwork and tenacity, our lawyers deliver the highest quality advice and novel solutions to our clients’ legal issues. **The Opportunity**

We are seeking a **Legal Technology Project Coordinator** to join our Firm. This position will be based in our New York office (hybrid).

**Position Overview**

Manage all aspects of discovery in litigation and regulatory matters using the Firm's legal technology solutions, providing consultative support and applying the Firm's electronic discovery best practices and project management strategies to manage cases efficiently and effectively. This position requires an in-depth understanding of the litigation life cycle, legal technology and electronic discovery.

**Responsibilities**

* Advise attorneys, paralegals and clients on electronic discovery best practices and consult on processes from collection through post-production tasks.
* Liaise with internal case teams, clients, vendors and the Legal Technology staff to support matters throughout all phases of discovery and offer recommendations about design, processes and workflows, including drafting project specifications for vendors.
* Maintain awareness of latest electronic discovery trends and be able to assess any impact they may have on Legal Technology workflows.
* Clearly articulate potential risks and provide possible solutions regarding collection, processing, review and production. Identify issues to escalate to Legal Technology management team.
* Demonstrate a thorough understanding of the Firm's litigation support software as it pertains to hosting document reviews, preparing productions and performing advanced searches.
* Assist with vendor selection and engagement process in consultation with Legal Technology management and attorneys to ensure the Firm’s vendor engagement procedures are followed including execution of agreements and conducting of security assessments.
* Manage basic aspects of collection, including identification of all sources and locations of electronically stored information.
* Manage all aspects of data processing, including coordinating with processing vendors, tracking custodians reviewing search terms, providing date ranges, determining optimal deduplication methods and troubleshooting processing issues. Communicate detailed processing specifications and instructions to the vendor.
* Manage all aspects of review, including set-up and design of the review database; access permissions, managed review providers and third party vendors; and development of a workflow.
* Manage all aspects of document production preparation, including reviewing production specifications with attorneys for best practices and strategic considerations; insuring productions are consistent and conform to any subpoenas, ESI protocols, joint defense agreements, etc.; running full quality control checks against any proposed production sets in coordination with the Paralegal Discovery Team and working with attorneys to resolve any issues found; and coordinating timing and technical resources with Legal Technology Data Specialists to ensure deadlines are met.
* Conduct quality check on final production volumes and media, including productions prepared by external vendors.

* Effectively communicate and provide end-user support and customer service to partners, co-counsel, case teams and clients throughout all phases of litigation and regulatory matters.
* Track progress of projects by maintaining and updating project files and documentation. Update internal case teams and clients as needed.
* Review and verify vendor invoices to ensure costs are consistent with the work performed and with relevant matter budgets.
* Work with Legal Technology management to develop recommendations, proposals, plans, cost estimates, budgets, procedures and specifications for new matters.
* Demonstrate effective interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills to facilitate effective work relationships with others.
* Manage Firm resources responsibly.
* Complies with and understands Firm operation, policies and procedures.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Knowledge of relevant firm computer software programs (e.g., Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint), with the ability to learn new software and operating systems
* Understanding of all aspects of the EDRM and of electronic discovery best practices, trends and techniques
* Understanding of analytics software, technology assisted review and workflows
* Familiarity with various electronic discovery platforms, including Relativity
* Understanding of basic litigation processes, including trial procedures
* Demonstrates effective interpersonal and communication skills, both verbally and in writing
* Demonstrates close attention to detail
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, organizational, and planning skills
* Strong project management skills

**About America On Tech:**

America On Tech (AOT) is a national nonprofit preparing the next generation of technology leaders from underestimated communities. Since 2014, AOT has provided no-cost tech education and workforce training to students in NYC, LA, Miami, and Atlanta. AOT equips young people with in-demand skills in AI, Web Development, Data Science, and more, creating pathways to higher education and careers. Learn more at www.americaontech.org.

**About the Apple Ecosystem and Swift Training Program**

The Apple Ecosystem and Swift Training Program is a flagship collaboration between America On Tech (AOT), Apple, the Hispanic Federation (HF), and CUNY. The program equips York College students and local community members with critical digital literacy and coding skills, creating pathways into technology careers.

In 2027, the program will train over 200 individuals across three learning tracks:

* **Apple Ecosystem Digital Literacy & Skills:** Short courses on foundational digital tools (e.g., Email, Numbers, Keynote, Pages, Resume Writing).
* **Intro to Swift Training:** Short courses to learn basic Swift skills and used as a recruitment tool for longer term SWIFT Training Course
* **NC3 Swift Certification Training:** A 96-hour NC3 Swift Certification Training preparing students for industry-recognized credentials.

All classes are held in-person at York College (94-20 Guy R. Brewer Blvd., Jamaica, NY 11451). Each class will include approximately 25 students, a mix of York College students and community members.

### **Position Overview**

America On Tech (AOT) is seeking a Program Coordinator to support the planning, operations, and execution of the Apple Ecosystem and Swift courses from February–December 2027, with onboarding beginning in January 2027. The coordinator will serve as the primary point of contact for students, instructors, and partners to ensure seamless program delivery. This role requires excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, as well as a strong commitment to supporting underestimated students in technology.

The Program Coordinator will work closely with AOT, HF, York College, and Apple staff to manage logistics, support student recruitment and classroom operations.

This role offers the opportunity to be at the forefront of innovative community technology education and to directly impact the career pathways of 200 underestimated students in technology.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Program Logistics (60%)

  + Serve as the primary contact for student inquiries.
  + Support students with wraparound services (resume prep, career coaching referrals, access to HF/AOT services).
* Program Monitoring & Reporting (20%)

  + Identify and escalate challenges promptly to AOT leadership.

It's more than a job; it's a calling. It's where passion meets purpose. ADAPT Community Network, formerly United Cerebral Palsy (UCP) of NYC provides a multitude of services to people with developmental disabilities. At ADAPT, we are 3,000 strong, and it takes every one of us to empower the lives of the people we support. With caring and great resources at hand, we know what it takes to help people live fuller, happier, healthier lives. Our employees show their commitment to the people we support every day, and we all deliver on our promise to provide innovative and comprehensive services to individuals with developmental disabilities.

For your next career move, apply with us at ADAPT Community Network! Wherever you work among our many locations around New York City, ADAPT offers paid training, competitive benefits, and we foster a team culture of learning, support, collaboration and career growth.

**SUMMARY**

Under the general direction of the program director or designee, the Residence Program Specialist is responsible for supporting the care, development, and independence of individuals living in an ADAPT Community Network residential facility. The Residence Program Specialist provides direct support, skill-building, and advocacy to ensure that the people we support achieve their personal goals and enjoy the highest quality of life possible.

* Provides care and supports the people we support in achieving greater independence and personal development.

* High School Diploma or GED required.

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for working effectively with the people we support, families, coworkers, and community partners.
* Ability to respond appropriately to crisis situations and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding the rights of the people we support.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**COMPENSATION:** $20.17/hour (after probation) + Industry-Leading Benefits for all full-time employees.

**Required:**

new_jobs.title: Social Media Manager
new_jobs.description:
Hawksmoor is a British steakhouse group, currently ranked No. 2 in the world among multi-site steakhouse groups by the World's 101 Best Steak Restaurants awards. We have three restaurants in the US: New York, Boston and Chicago, and this role owns the organic social media strategy across all of them, working alongside our Senior Group Content and Social Strategy Lead.

Our growth in the US rests on the same obsession that built the brand in the UK: real sourcing, real cooking, and a genuine point of view, carried through everything from the menu to the media we put out. This role is responsible for turning that into a considered, confident organic social strategy that builds Hawksmoor's reputation across three major US markets, and then for executing it hands-on, building the strategy and creating the content that brings it to life, in close partnership with our UK-based brand marketing team.

Key Responsibilities:

*Strategy & Planning*

* Collaborate with the Senior Group Content and Social Strategy Lead to develop and present the U.S. organic social media strategy in line with Hawksmoor’s business objectives and marketing calendar.
* Create and maintain monthly and quarterly social media plans for U.S. restaurants, aligned with wider business activity and culturally relevant moments.
* Act as the primary lead for Hawksmoor’s social media presence in the U.S., while working closely with the broader marketing team to ensure consistency of tone and brand messaging across regions.
* Build and present the US organic social strategy with the Group Senior Content Manager, tying every plan back to Hawksmoor's business objectives and marketing calendar.
* Turn brand plans and business goals into monthly and quarterly social plans for all three US restaurants, timed to wider business activity and moments that actually matter to our audience.
* Own the US social presence day to day, working with the wider marketing team to keep tone and message consistent across the UK and US.

*Content & Scheduling*

* Manage day-to-day channel activity, including community management, across all platforms for the US market
* Ensure cohesion between social media activity and wider marketing channels
* Proactively introduce creative social campaigns tied to brand activity, business objectives and cultural moments
* Brief and collaborate with internal teams and external partners as required
* Educate and upskill the wider marketing team on social media trends and platform best practice
* Know which content works on which platform for which audience, and plan accordingly rather than posting the same thing everywhere.
* Plan and schedule daily activity so campaigns land on time and stay relevant.

*Community & Engagement*

* Build genuine community, not just reply to comments and DMs on time, though that matters too. The goal is people who follow because they feel part of something.
* Build relationships with local influencers, creators and partners who fit the brand, to extend reach in each city.
* Spot opportunities for co-creation, user-generated content and local partnerships.

*Insights & Performance*

* Track performance and use the data to sharpen content, not just to report on it.
* Report regularly on activity and results, and use what you learn to adjust strategy.
* Stay ahead of platform and algorithm changes, and know what's worth acting on versus what's just noise.

Requirements:

* 3–5 years' proven experience managing social media across multiple channels and content types, ideally in hospitality, food & beverage, lifestyle or another premium, consumer-facing brand.
* Hands-on, proven experience managing Facebook, Instagram, TikTok end-to-end with a track record of managing high-volume channels with large followings.
* A track record of turning brand plans and business objectives into organic social strategy that actually delivers.
* Real platform and audience expertise: you know what content works on which platform for which audience
* Exceptional attention to detail, the kind that shows up in every caption, crop and post time.
* A quality-first instinct rather than a trend-chasing one. Our guest is 35+ and discerning; we want someone who can build content with real craft and restraint, not something that only works because it's this week's trend.
* Experience building community and engagement, not just managing it. Growing genuine audience connection rather than just responding to comments and messages.
* Sharp instincts for algorithm shifts, platform changes and emerging opportunities, and the initiative to act on them early.
* Content / asset creation skills a bonus but not necessity (Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, CapCut or similar).
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with real command of tone and brand voice.
* Comfortable in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities, which is normal in hospitality, and able to reprioritize without losing quality.
* Highly organized, confident managing your own timeline across time zones with the UK team.
* Pride in the work: every post represents the whole restaurant, and you treat it that way.
* Willingness to travel semi-regularly between New York, Boston and Chicago.

SafeZone24 is an established commercial security systems integrator with over 25 years of industry experience. We specialize in professional video surveillance (CCTV), access control, intrusion alarms, intercom systems, remote monitoring, and integrated security solutions.

We serve commercial properties, real estate developers, property management companies, construction firms, schools, houses of worship, community organizations, and other institutions throughout New York, New Jersey, the Tri-State region, and surrounding markets.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, self-motivated B2B Sales Representative or Business Development Professional who knows how to identify opportunities, build relationships, and bring in new projects.

This opportunity is ideal for someone with existing connections in commercial real estate, construction, property management, facilities management, or the security industry.

You focus on bringing in business. SafeZone24 provides the technical expertise, system design, project estimating, installation, and ongoing support.

Independent Contractor Opportunity

This opportunity is intended for an independent sales professional who operates their own business, controls their schedule and prospecting methods, and may represent other companies.

No daily office attendance is required. The representative independently develops business opportunities and coordinates with SafeZone24 when qualified projects are identified.

The relationship is intended to be governed by a written independent sales agreement, subject to applicable law.

Responsibilities

* Independently identify and pursue new commercial and institutional clients.
* Build relationships with property owners, developers, contractors, facility managers, and decision-makers.
* Generate qualified project opportunities through networking, outreach, and existing professional connections.

* Follow up on proposals and help convert opportunities into signed projects.
* Develop long-term relationships that generate repeat business.
* Pursue business opportunities throughout New York, New Jersey, the Tri-State region, and surrounding markets.

Compensation

**This is a 100% commission-based opportunity with no guaranteed base salary.**

* Earn competitive commissions on qualifying new business you personally generate.
* Commissions are calculated based on eligible customer payments actually collected by SafeZone24.
* For projects paid in installments, commissions are calculated proportionally as eligible payments are received.
* No commission is paid merely for introductions, meetings, or proposals.
* Commission percentages, eligibility, earning and payment terms, and any adjustments will be defined in a written agreement compliant with applicable law.
* There is no guaranteed annual income. Earnings depend on successful business generation and customer collections.

Qualifications

* Demonstrated experience in B2B sales, business development, or commercial account acquisition.

* Experience in security systems, low-voltage technology, construction, commercial real estate, or related industries strongly preferred.
* Existing relationships with commercial property owners, developers, contractors, or facility managers are a significant advantage.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to attend client meetings and site visits throughout the Tri-State region and surrounding markets.

* Established company with 25+ years of industry experience.
* Broad portfolio of commercial and institutional security solutions.
* Professional technical team handling design, estimating, installation, and service.
* Opportunity to generate business across multiple markets and industries.
* Freedom to independently manage your schedule and business-development activities.
* Performance-based earning potential tied to successful projects.

**If you have the industry connections, sales experience, and drive to bring in commercial projects, we'd like to hear from you.**

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

We empower teams to build the best products and experiences by embedding real human perspectives into every stage of the development process—from ideation to launch. With the world’s strongest participant network, AI-powered analysis, expert services, and seamless integrations, we help companies eliminate guesswork, align stakeholders, and bring customer needs into sharp focus.

  

Trusted by more than 3,000 organizations worldwide—including 75 of the Fortune 100— Auros delivers measurable business outcomes, reduces risk, and helps teams deliver with confidence. Joining our team means being part of a passionate group focused on transforming how companies understand and connect with their customers.

  

Let’s build experiences people love—together.

  
  

**The Opportunity**

As a Digital Scaled Customer Success Manager, you own the health and success of a broad portfolio of UserTesting and User Interviews customers through a combination of digital engagement, data-driven intervention, automation, and targeted human touch.

  

This is not a traditional one-to-one Customer Success role, nor is it a support role. Your job is to determine how we deliver the right Customer Success experience to the right customer at the right moment — whether that means an automated journey reaching hundreds of customers or a personal intervention with one account showing meaningful risk or opportunity.

  

You will operate with a commercial mindset and a bias toward scale. You will use customer data, technology, experimentation, and AI to identify patterns across your portfolio and turn those insights into programs that improve adoption, retention, and growth. Success in this role isn't measured by how many meetings you hold. It's measured by the customer outcomes you create at scale.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Portfolio Health & Retention: Own the health of a broad portfolio of customers and proactively identify the signals that matter most. Use product adoption, engagement, sentiment, lifecycle, and commercial data to identify risk early and create interventions that improve retention and customer outcomes.
* Scaled Customer Engagement: Design and execute one-to-many customer experiences across the lifecycle, including onboarding, adoption, education, value reinforcement, renewal readiness, and re-engagement. Determine when automation is the right answer and when a targeted human interaction will create greater impact.
* Adoption & Value Realisation: Help customers move from access to adoption to measurable value. Identify common barriers across your portfolio and build repeatable programs, resources, campaigns, and interventions that help customers get more from UserTesting without requiring every customer to have a dedicated CSM.
* Retention & Growth: Partner with Sales and Account Executives to support the commercial outcomes of your portfolio. Surface churn risk, expansion signals, and customer intent early enough for the broader account team to act. Create scalable motions that improve renewal readiness and uncover opportunities for deeper adoption and growth.
* Data-Driven Prioritisation: Use customer data to determine where your time will have the greatest impact. Build and refine segmentation, triggers, health signals, and engagement strategies rather than treating every account the same. Continuously evaluate which interventions are working and adjust based on measurable outcomes.
* Digital Journey Ownership: Help build and continuously improve the digital Customer Success experience within tools such as Planhat, Salesforce, Marketo, in-app engagement, webinars, email, and other customer channels. Look for opportunities to replace repetitive manual work with scalable, thoughtful customer experiences.
* AI & Automation: Actively experiment with AI and automation to make Customer Success more proactive, personalised, and efficient. Identify repetitive workflows, customer signals, and engagement opportunities that can be automated while maintaining a high-quality customer experience.
* Targeted Human Engagement: Know when scale should stop. Step directly into customer relationships when data indicates meaningful risk, opportunity, or complexity. Lead targeted conversations, office hours, workshops, or other engagements where human intervention can materially change the customer outcome.
* Customer Advocacy: Identify advocates across the portfolio and create scalable ways to generate references, testimonials, case studies, community participation, and customer feedback. Represent the patterns you see across hundreds of customers internally so Product and Go-to-Market teams understand not just individual requests, but broader customer trends.
* Experimentation & Continuous Improvement: Treat Digital Customer Success as a system that can always be improved. Develop hypotheses, launch experiments, measure results, and scale what works. Share learnings with the wider Customer Success organisation so successful digital motions can influence how we serve customers across every segment.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Professional Services, Support, Operations, and the wider Customer Success organisation. Digital Customer Success sits at the intersection of these teams, and you will help connect customer signals to the teams best positioned to act on them.

* A commercial mindset and an understanding of how adoption, engagement, retention, and expansion connect to one another.

new_jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager – Americas South
new_jobs.description:
**Our company**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do**

You will be accountable for marketing’s contribution to pipeline for your region. You carry specific pipeline goals and delivering them is your priority. If it doesn't contribute directly to pipeline, we don't do it.

You will be the marketing partner that regional GTM teams turn to first. Working with sales leaders to develop the regional marketing plan, you will turn global programs into campaigns that are highly relevant to your accounts and show how Teradata can solve their problems. Your work accelerates the sales cycle, generates new pipeline from existing customers and new logos, and strengthens customer preference for Teradata’s solutions.

**What You'll Bring**

You own the outcome, not the activity. You judge your work by pipeline created, and treat event attendance, click rates, and even MQLs as signals, not the goal. When pipeline is behind plan, you flag it early, bring options, and change course.

You are a partner to sales, not an order taker. You start with the customer’s problem, not the product, and you choose the activity that makes selling easier over the one that only fills the calendar.

You ask why we do things the way we do, and you don’t settle for “that’s how it’s always been”. You challenge colleagues, from sales leaders to marketing teammates to your own manager, when you see a better way. You do it constructively and always focused on the outcome, and you welcome being challenged back. You try something different when the usual play stops working, share what you learned, and stop what isn’t working, even when it was your idea.

What you say will happen, happens: on time, with the follow-up planned and nobody chasing you. You give colleagues honest feedback and make the people around you better.

*Not for you if:* you measure success by events run or campaigns launched, you wait for a brief rather than help shape the plan, or you would rather perfect a plan than get it into market. It’s also not for you if follow-up, attribution, and reporting feel like someone else’s job.

*Essential Duties and Responsibilities*

Own marketing pipeline for Americas South

* Forecast and track pipeline contribution against your goals, and build the programs needed to close any gap
* Build the regional marketing plan with sales leaders leveraging global programs, localizing only where it moves pipeline and balancing existing customers with new logos
* Build strong working relationships with sales leaders and account teams, aligning programs to account priorities and deal progression, and agreeing priorities in regular pipeline conversations

Turn programs into pipeline

* Deliver cross-channel demand generation programs end-to-end, from planning and build through to execution and follow-up – every activity is part of a journey that leads toward measurable pipeline impact
* Execute ABM programs for named and cluster accounts, including buying committee mapping and account-level content, in platforms such as Influ2
* Be the marketing expert regional GTM teams rely on, keeping sales leaders, account teams, and SDRs briefed on what’s coming, what it means for their accounts, and what to do next
* Travel domestically and internationally to bring your programs to life in market, and stay close to the sales teams you support

Let the data decide

* Own reporting on full-funnel performance, pipeline, conversion, and ROI by program, account, and segment
* Move budget and effort toward what works and away from what doesn't, managing the regional calendar and budget

**Who You'll Work With**

* Day to day: regional sales leaders, account teams, and SDRs, staying close on pipeline and follow-up through regular conversations
* Regularly: your field marketing leader, Americas field marketing colleagues and the global demand generation and field marketing team

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor's degree
* At least 5 years in B2B marketing (field marketing, demand generation, or ABM), ideally in enterprise software, data, analytics, or AI
* A track record of delivering against pipeline or revenue goals that you can show in numbers
* Working proficiency in Salesforce, including campaign and pipeline reporting
* Hands-on ABM and demand generation experience, ideally with platforms such as Influ2 and Eloqua
* Experience as the marketing partner to a regional sales team, with confidence influencing sales leaders

**Why We Think You'll Love Teradata**

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

All other permanent roles will be eligible for one of our annual incentive plans, which are based on company financial attainment and individual performance.
