As an **In Home Sales Representative** supporting our NEW Sam's Club partnership you will play a pivotal role in delivering in-home design consultations for Sam's Club Members interested in transforming their bath and shower systems. Your ability to build rapport, understand customer needs, and effectively communicate the benefits of our innovative bath remodeling products and services will be essential to your success. If you are passionate about closing sales, enjoy working with people, and have a drive to exceed goals, we want you on our team!

* Attend pre-scheduled appointments, **no cold calling** or prospecting required.
* Conduct in-home design consultations with prospective clients to assess their bathroom remodeling needs and offer suitable solutions.
* Effectively assess customer needs and present tailored remodeling solutions that align with both design preferences and functionality.
* Explain product features, benefits, and pricing clearly to customers to aid their decision-making process.
* Provide a high level of customer service, building trust and rapport throughout the consultation process.

* 2 weeks of interactive virtual training; must take and pass written and practical assessments.

As a coordinator, you’ll:

* Coordinate fitness and wellness programs for students, faculty, and staff, including leading fitness classes and wellness initiatives as needed
* Plan, coordinate, promote, and implement intramural and recreational programs, leagues, tournaments, activities, special events, and evening and weekend programs
* Assist with the development, expansion, and leadership of outdoor recreation opportunities and support participation in university-wide programs and events
* Provide facility, event, recreation, or operational assistance for SCAD Athletics
* Plan, coordinate, promote, and implement programs and events that foster participation, build community, and enhance the overall student experience

Additionally, you’ll:

* Provide a welcoming, professional, and inclusive environment for students, faculty, staff, and guests
* Address participant concerns to resolve issues appropriately through superb customer service
* Enforce building rules, policies, and safety procedures; promote safe participation and proper equipment use; and respond appropriately to injuries, emergencies, incidents, and other operational concerns, including contacting University Safety or emergency services as needed

Candidates should ideally demonstrate:

* Strong customer service, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills
* Ability to multitask and successfully work with others
* Responsibility and reliability
* Knowledge of fitness facility operations, cardio and strength-training equipment, and safe equipment use

**Minimum qualifications:**

* Experience supervising, scheduling, and training students or part-time employees
* Able to accommodate a changing schedule based on university needs, including evening and weekend hours
* Able to travel as needed

**Preferred qualifications:**

* At least six months of operations experience in a fitness center

**Certificates, licenses, and registrations:**

* Personal training certification from NSCA, NASM, ISSA, ACE, or another nationally accredited organization
* CPR and AED certification or ability to obtain it

**Travel required:**

* Less than 10%

**Work hours:** The university work week is Sunday through Saturday. Most offices are open Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. To accommodate business needs, employees may be assigned to other workdays and/or hours, including weekends and evenings.

SCAD is committed to fostering a community of respect that is welcoming to all. The innovative spirit at SCAD enriches inclusion by empowering everyone to comfortably be one's authentic self. new_jobs.title: Ocean Freight Operations Coordinator - Import
new_jobs.description:
**About Toll Group**

At Toll, we do more than just logistics - we move the businesses that move the world. Our 16,000 team members can help solve any logistics, transport, or supply chain challenge – big or small. We have been supporting our customers for more than 130 years. Today, we support more than 20,000 customers worldwide with 500 sites in 27 markets, and a forwarding network spanning 150 countries. We are proudly part of Japan Post — www.tollgroup.com

**PURPOSE OF THE JOB**

The Ocean Freight Operations Coordinator - Import is responsible for supporting day-to-day ocean freight operations across import, and domestic transport activities. This role ensures accurate documentation, timely cargo movement, and effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders to maintain service standards and operational efficiency.

**PRIMARY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

· Coordinate ocean shipments for Ocean import, including booking and documentation.

· Liaise with shipping lines, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and transport providers to facilitate cargo movement.

· Prepare and process essential documentation such as bills of lading and customs declarations.

· Track shipments and update internal systems (e.g., CargoWise One); notify stakeholders of delays or changes.

· Arrange local transport and warehouse interactions for cargo pick-up and delivery.

· Maintain accurate shipment records and ensure compliance with customs and maritime regulations.

· Respond to customer inquiries and provide booking confirmations promptly.

· Support invoicing and basic cost entry tasks as directed by senior team members.

· Assist with general administrative tasks to ensure smooth operational workflow.

**Previous Work Experience & Qualifications**

* 1–2 years’ experience in ocean freight or logistics operations (entry-level candidates with relevant training may be considered).
* Basic understanding of customs and maritime regulations.
* Familiarity with freight management systems and Microsoft Office.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Team-oriented with a proactive and customer-focused approach.
* Willingness to learn and take on varied operational tasks.

**What moves you?**

At Toll, you can help play a vital role in delivering what matters. From food, fuel, medicine and rescue services, we keep businesses and communities thriving. Every day brings change. We see that as an opportunity. To be curious. To ask the right questions. And build meaningful connections. Because finding new ways to solve problems is what we do. With a bold vision to expand our global reach, our 16,000+ people bring a passion for progress. We collaborate in friendly, caring teams, supported by approachable leaders who give us the autonomy to quickly make decisions with impact. Learn and grow with industry-leading training, alongside talented experts. Feel empowered to take on diverse challenges and new responsibilities to move you, our customers, and our world further.

Are you excited about this role but are concerned you don’t meet all the requirements? If you have similar skills and are willing to learn then we encourage you to apply anyway. We know that some people hesitate to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Toll, we value a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re interested in this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly then please talk to us – you may be just the right candidate for this or other roles we have coming up.

At Toll everyone is welcome including those of all ages, ethnicities, genders and abilities.

To find out more about us visit www.careers.tollgroup.com

You must be entitled to work in United States of America and be prepared to undertake pre-employment checks including a criminal history check and medical.

new_jobs.description:
Executive Assistant & Real Estate Coordinator

**Location:** Glenview, IL  
**Job Type:** Full-Time, W-2 Employee  
**Salary:** $50,000–$60,000 annually, based on experience  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, approximately 40 hours per week, with occasional evening and weekend flexibility  
**Work Location:** Primarily in-office in Glenview, with local fieldwork throughout Chicago's northern and northwestern suburbs

About the Opportunity

We are a growing real estate business involved in residential sales, property investments, renovations, and property management.

We're looking for a highly organized, motivated, and resourceful Executive Assistant & Real Estate Coordinator to work directly alongside the owner and help manage the day-to-day responsibilities of a busy real estate business.

**This is not your typical desk job.**

One day you might be preparing a home for the market, coordinating marketing materials, or organizing contracts. The next day you could be visiting properties, meeting contractors, managing schedules, or helping solve an unexpected issue.

We're looking for someone who enjoys variety, takes pride in getting things done, and doesn't need to be constantly told what to do next.

The ideal candidate is proactive, dependable, detail-oriented, comfortable with technology, and capable of managing multiple responsibilities independently.

Key Responsibilities

**Executive & Administrative Assistance**

* Manage the owner's calendar, appointments, scheduling, and reminders.
* Coordinate meetings, follow-ups, and day-to-day business activities.
* Organize documents, maintain records, and keep important deadlines on track.
* Research information, find solutions, and assist with miscellaneous business assignments.
* Handle occasional personal errands and appointments.
* Anticipate upcoming needs and proactively complete tasks without constant direction.

**Real Estate Listing & Transaction Coordination**

* Coordinate residential real estate listings from preparation through closing.
* Schedule photography, inspections, showings, and other property-related appointments.
* Create and coordinate listing brochures, flyers, social media materials, and other marketing content.
* Prepare and organize contracts, disclosures, and transaction documents for appropriate review and approval.
* Communicate with attorneys, lenders, inspectors, vendors, clients, and other parties.
* Track contract deadlines and ensure required paperwork is completed.
* Maintain accurate listing and transaction files.
* Assist with MLS-related administrative work as permitted by licensing requirements.

**Field Operations & Property Support**

* Visit residential properties throughout the Chicago suburbs.
* Install lockboxes and coordinate property access.
* Take property photos, document conditions, and report findings.
* Meet inspectors, photographers, contractors, and other service providers at properties.
* Complete property checks, supply runs, and miscellaneous field assignments.
* Support rental property operations through occasional property visits and supply coordination.
* Conduct showings or other licensed activities when properly licensed and authorized.

**Client Database & Marketing**

* Maintain and organize the client and prospect database.
* Help develop and execute approved past-client marketing and referral campaigns.
* Assist with client communications, follow-ups, and special events.
* Create marketing materials using modern technology and AI tools.
* Identify opportunities to improve client engagement and repeat business.

**Real Estate Investment Support**

* Assist with property research and comparable sales analysis.
* Support investment property acquisitions through administrative coordination and fieldwork.
* Help organize acquisition documents and property information.
* Opportunity to grow into additional acquisitions responsibilities based on performance, experience, and licensing.

What We're Looking For

**Required Qualifications**

* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and problem-solving abilities.
* Dependable, punctual, and accountable.
* Ability to independently prioritize and complete multiple tasks.
* Strong computer skills and familiarity with modern business software.
* Experience with or willingness to use AI tools to improve efficiency.
* Comfortable working in both an office and field environment.
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and willingness to travel locally.
* Ability to work primarily from our Glenview office and accommodate occasional evening or weekend assignments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous real estate, executive assistant, transaction coordination, or operations experience.
* Illinois real estate license, or willingness to obtain one.
* Experience with CRM software and task management systems.
* Familiarity with real estate contracts, listings, and transaction procedures.
* Experience with Canva, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar tools.
* Comfortable creating marketing materials and managing projects.

**We value initiative, intelligence, reliability, and attitude just as much as experience.**

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?

We are looking for someone who:

* Takes ownership of responsibilities from beginning to end.
* Anticipates what needs to happen instead of waiting for instructions.
* Follows through and communicates completion without being chased.
* Is comfortable juggling multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Enjoys solving problems and finding better ways to accomplish tasks.
* Takes pride in being dependable and helping a business run smoothly.
* Is flexible, positive, resourceful, and willing to jump in where needed.

Compensation & Benefits

* Annual salary of $50,000–$60,000, depending on experience and qualifications.
* Full-time W-2 employment.
* Vehicle allowance and applicable business expense reimbursement.
* Initial 40

Events Manager

new_jobs.description:
MC Machinery Systems, Inc.

Job Description

Job Title: Sales Operations Coordinator

DESCRIPTION:

The Sales Operations Coordinator is a key member of the Sales Operations team, responsible for orchestrating complex sales processes, managing contract administration, and supporting cross-functional collaboration. This role combines advanced administrative expertise, process optimization, and project management to ensure seamless execution of sales activities and superior customer experience. The Sales Operations Coordinator will drive continuous improvement, and serve as a liaison between Sales, Logistics, Purchasing, Accounting, and other departments.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

Sales Process & Operations:

* Receive, review, and process purchase orders; collaborate with Sales Liaison and Sales Operations to resolve pending issues and ensure order accuracy.
* Allocate inventory and machines/models for incoming sales, maintaining up-to-date spreadsheets and ETA/cost updates.
* Oversee client engagement and outreach throughout the sales cycle, supporting machine sales and post-sale follow-up.
* Monitor sales and delivery reports and coordinate with Senior Sales Operations Coordinators on changes needed.
* Support project management by tracking deadlines, monitoring progress, and following up on outstanding issues.
* Ensure data integrity across ERP/Salesforce systems (Microsoft Dynamics AX preferred).
* Generate and submit back-order reports, support monthly, quarterly, and annual closings in collaboration with accounting.
* Support the GM of Sales Operations with special projects, contract reviews, and operational requests.
* Collaborate with regionals, direct sales, and dealers on inventory availability and order fulfillment.
* Coordinate with Logistics, Purchasing, Installations, and Accounting to support machine sales, inventory management, and service transfers.
* Support international shipping processes, including duty drawback, customs documentation, and logistics coordination.

Contract Management & Administration:

* Assist with preparation, review, and administration of subcontracts, vendor agreements, consultant agreements, NDAs, teaming agreements, purchase orders, MOUs, and inter-organization work transfers.
* Review contract documents for compliance (including FAR), notify management of new contracts, modifications, renewals, and critical actions.
* Maintain official subcontract/vendor/consultant files and distribute contract documentation as required.
* Respond to inquiries, provide reports containing requested contract data, and resolve day-to-day contract administration issues.
* Perform audits and support compliance measures for contract and sales operations.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

* Strong organizational, project, and time management skills.
* Advanced judgment, problem-solving, and proactive approach.
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize workload in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Experience with ERP/Salesforce systems; Microsoft Dynamics AX preferred.
* Contract review and compliance.
* Experience supporting international sales and logistics.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Business, or related field preferred.
* 5+ years’ experience in sales coordination, administration, or related roles.
* Demonstrated experience in contract management and sales operations.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

Job operates mainly indoors but exposed to generally consistent conditions, such as regulated air conditioning and heating. This job also works near a machinery showroom, which may generate some noises such as objects hitting the floor and creating a sound, forklift movement and occasional other short term noises.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

This job requires prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Repetitive use of the hands and typing are required. Requires frequent lifting of 1-10 pounds and occasional 11-25 pounds with infrequent lifting of 25 or more. Must be able to access and navigate each department at the organization’s facilities.

EEO STATEMENT:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

College Student Care and Support

**About the Department**

College Student Care and Support

**Job Summary**

Reporting to the Associate Director, Student Care Coordination, the Operations Coordinator, Student Care Coordination provides administrative and operational support to the Care and Support Team. The position helps ensure efficient office operations by managing student support processes, shared communications, confidential student records, case assignment workflows, and event and website support. * Maintains accurate, up-to-date, and confidential student records in Maxient and other applicable systems, including data entry, document management, case notes, and record organization.
* Supports office processes with accuracy, discretion, and attention to detail, particularly when handling sensitive student matters, private student information, and time-sensitive documentation.
* Manages and respond to shared office email inboxes by monitoring incoming messages, providing accurate and timely information, triaging inquiries, and routing matters to appropriate staff or campus partners.
* Communicates professionally and compassionately with students, faculty, staff, and campus partners, serving as a helpful point of contact who represents the office in a responsive and student-centered manner.

new_jobs.description:
**About us**  
Universal Wellness Roscoe Village is a chiropractic and SoftWave clinic on Belmont Avenue serving English- and Spanish-speaking patients across the North Side. Our patients get results and tell their friends. Now we want to build that into a real system.

We’re hiring someone to grow our marketing the long-lasting way: through content people actually want to watch, relationships with local health and fitness professionals, and real follow-through with the people who come to our workshops. You’ll build the side of our marketing that doesn’t depend on paid ads, and it keeps growing the longer you’re here.

**What you’ll do**

* **Create content that builds trust.** Plan, film, edit and post short-form video and content for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and our Google profile. That means patient stories (with permission), education, behind the scenes, and the faces of our team. English and Spanish content is a big plus.
* **Turn workshop attendees into patients.** Follow up personally with everyone who attends or registers for our workshops, by call, text and email. Answer their questions, invite them back, and help them take the next step. You’ll build relationships over days and weeks, not answer a ringing phone.
* **Build our professional referral network.** Develop relationships with physical therapists, personal trainers, gyms, yoga and Pilates studios, massage therapists, podiatrists, primary care offices and local employers. Set up lunch-and-learns, co-hosted workshops and partner events, and keep those relationships active.
* **Show up in the community.** Help plan and represent us at neighborhood events, markets and partner gatherings in Roscoe Village, Lakeview and nearby.
* **Grow our reputation.** Run patient referral campaigns, Google reviews, and outreach to past patients.
* **Track what works.** Keep a simple weekly report on content, workshop follow-up, referral partners, and how many new patients came from each.

**You might be a fit if you**

* Have 1–3 years in marketing, social media, community outreach or partnerships (healthcare, fitness, wellness or med spa is a plus)
* Can shoot and edit short video on your phone and design in Canva
* Are comfortable on camera and love meeting people in person
* Build relationships naturally and follow up without being reminded
* Email marketing (newsletters, events, CRM)
* Stay organized, and have used a CRM or are happy to learn one (GoHighLevel is a plus)
* Speak Spanish (strongly preferred; many of our patients do)

**Schedule**  
Monday–Thursday, in the office, with flexible Friday hours. Some evening workshops and summer weekend events, as well as driving around the city establishing professional referral relationships.

**Benefits**

* Base salary plus a monthly performance bonus (Earning potential up to $45K)
* Health insurance
* 401(k) with company match

**To apply**  
Send your resume and a link to something you’ve made or grown, such as a social account, video, campaign or community event. Tell us in two sentences what results it produced for you or your client.
